war: Sanglit nahangyo ako ha iyo nga pahibaroon hiya niyo nga hinihigugma pa hiya niyo.

en: in order that Satan might not outwit us. For we are not unaware of his schemes.
war: basi diri kita madaog ni Satanas; kay maaram kita han iya mga ginhuhunahunaan.

en: Such confidence we have through Christ before God.
war: Nasiring kami hini kay natapod kami han Dyos pinaagi kan Cristo.

en: will not the ministry of the Spirit be even more glorious?
war: ano daw nga himaya an makikita ha pag-alagad han Espiritu!

en: And if what was transitory came with glory, how much greater is the glory of that which lasts!
war: Kay kon may kalamrag hadton lumalabay la, labi na hin kalamrag hadton himaya nga waray pagkatapos!

en: Therefore, since we have such a hope, we are very bold.
war: Nadasig kami kay may-ada kami hini nga paglaom.

en: Even to this day when Moses is read, a veil covers their hearts.
war: Bisan yana kon nagbabasa hira han Balaod ni Moises an ira mga hunahuna natatahoban pa gihapon han biray.

en: But whenever anyone turns to the Lord, the veil is taken away.
war: Kundi nakukuha ini, sumala han siring han Kasuratan, “Nakuha an biray ni Moises han pagdangop niya han Ginoo.”

en: Now the Lord is the Spirit, and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is freedom.
war: Yana, “an Ginoo” hini nga bahin han Kasuratan amo an Espiritu; ngan kon hain an Espiritu han Ginoo, may-ada kagawasan.

en: And even if our gospel is veiled, it is veiled to those who are perishing.
war: Kay kon an iginwawali namon nga Maupay nga Sumat diri hinsasabotan, diri ini hinsasabtan hadton diri matatalwas.

en: We are hard pressed on every side, but not crushed; perplexed, but not in despair;
war: Agsob kami pagsakiton, kundi diri napupukan; nagruruhaduha kami usahay, kundi diri gud kami nagtuturaw.

en: So then, death is at work in us, but life is at work in you.
war: Karuyag sidngon hini nga aanhi ha amon an kamatayon; kundi aada ha iyo an kinabuhi.

en: Meanwhile we groan, longing to be clothed instead with our heavenly dwelling,
war: Ngan naaraba kita yana kay dako gud an aton paghingyap nga mahibutang dinhe ha aton an aton urokyan nga aadto ha langit.

en: because when we are clothed, we will not be found naked.
war: Kon masul-otan na kita hini, diri mahimo nga waray naton lawas.

en: For we live by faith, not by sight.
war: Kay nabubuhi kita pinaagi hin pagtoo ngan diri pinaagi hin butang nga kinikita.

en: We are confident, I say, and would prefer to be away from the body and at home with the Lord.
war: Nadasig gud kita ngan karuyag gud naton pagbaya han aton urokyan dida hini nga lawas ngan mag-ukoy kita upod han Ginoo.

en: So we make it our goal to please him, whether we are at home in the body or away from it.
war: Kundi labaw han ngatanan karuyag naton makalipay ha iya, ma anhi kita ha aton urokyan o ma adto kita upod ha Ginoo.

en: We put no stumbling block in anyone’s path, so that our ministry will not be discredited.
war: Diri namon karuyag nga may-ada ha iyo magsuson han amon buruhaton, sanglit diri man kami nag-uulang hin bisan hin-o ha iyo.

en: in beatings, imprisonments and riots; in hard work, sleepless nights and hunger;
war: Ginhampak kami, ginpriso, ngan ginraogdaog; nagtrabaho kami labaw han kaangayan ngan waray pagkaturog o waray namon pagkaon.

en: We have spoken freely to you, Corinthians, and opened wide our hearts to you.
war: Hinigugma nga kasangkayan ha Corinto! Nagyakan kami hin dayag ha iyo ngan waray namon iginlilirong ha iyo.

en: We are not withholding our affection from you, but you are withholding yours from us.
war: Labis an amon paghigugma ha iyo; kamo in kulang hin pagbati para ha amon.

en: What harmony is there between Christ and Belial ? Or what does a believer have in common with an unbeliever?
war: Uunanhon hin pagkauyon ni Cristo ngan han Yawa? Ano an ginkakaurusaan han magtinuohon ngan han diri magtinuohon?

en: But God, who comforts the downcast, comforted us by the coming of Titus,
war: Kundi gindasig kami han Dyos nga paralipay han mga mabidoon pinaagi han pag-abot ni Tito.

en: I am glad I can have complete confidence in you.
war: Malipayon gud ako nga hingpit an akon pagsarig ha iyo!

en: And now, brothers and sisters, we want you to know about the grace that God has given the Macedonian churches.
war: Kabugtoan, karuyag namon nga mahibaroan niyo an nabuhat han grasya han Dyos dida han mga singbahan ha Macedonia.

en: For I testify that they gave as much as they were able, and even beyond their ability. Entirely on their own,
war: Nakakapatapod ako ha iyo nga hinmatag hira sugad han ira nahimo ngan bangin sobra pa, kay ha ira kalugaringon nga kaburut-on,

en: they urgently pleaded with us for the privilege of sharing in this service to the Lord’s people.
war: naghangyo ngan nanginyupo gud hira ha amon nga makaamot hira hin pagtabang han mga magtinuohon ha Judea.

en: For if the willingness is there, the gift is acceptable according to what one has, not according to what one does not have.
war: Kon karuyag gud niyo humatag, kakarawton ini han Dyos sumala han sadang niyo ihatag, diri han waray dida ha iyo.

en: as it is written: “The one who gathered much did not have too much, and the one who gathered little did not have too little.”
war: Sugad han siring han Kasuratan: “An nagtirok hin damo waray magsobra, ngan an nagtirok hin gutiay waray magkulang.”

en: Thanks be to God, who put into the heart of Titus the same concern I have for you.
war: Dako an amon pagpasalamat han Dyos nga nagpasindak kan Tito hin pagbulig ha iyo sugad gud han amon kasindak hin pagbulig ha iyo!

en: We want to avoid any criticism of the way we administer this liberal gift.
war: Naghihirot kami nga waray sumuson mahitungod han paagi han pagdumara namon hini nga dako nga bulig.

en: There is no need for me to write to you about this service to the Lord’s people.
war: Diri na kinahanglan nga magsurat pa ako ha iyo mahitungod han mga bulig nga ginpadara ngadto han mga magtinuohon ha Judea.

en: As it is written: “They have freely scattered their gifts to the poor; their righteousness endures forever.”
war: Sugad han siring han Kasuratan: “Mahinatagon gud hiya ngadto han mga kablas; waray katapusan an iya pagkalooy.”

en: Thanks be to God for his indescribable gift!
war: Pagpasalamat kita han Dyos tungod han diri sadang mahiasoy nga hatag niya!

en: For though we live in the world, we do not wage war as the world does.
war: Matuod gad nga nag-uukoy kita dinhe ha kalibutan, kundi diri kita nakikig-away tungod hin kalibutanon nga mga panuyo.

en: And we will be ready to punish every act of disobedience, once your obedience is complete.
war: Ngan katapos niyo pagpakita han iyo tim-os nga pagkamasinugtanon, andam na kami hin pagsirot hin bisan ano nga pagsupak.

en: I do not want to seem to be trying to frighten you with my letters.
war: Diri ko karuyag nga maghunahuna kamo nga gintatarhog ko la kamo han akon mga surat.

en: I hope you will put up with me in a little foolishness. Yes, please put up with me!
war: Karuyag ko nga tugotan ako niyo bisan kon usahay may-ada ko gutiay nga kalurongan. Tugoti ako kon mahihimo!

en: I do not think I am in the least inferior to those “super-apostles.”
war: Pamati ko diri gad ako ubos han gimaupayi niyo nga mga “apostoles”!

en: Why? Because I do not love you? God knows I do!
war: Kay ano in pagsiring ko hini? Tungod ba nga diri ako nahigugma ha iyo? Maaram an Dyos nga hinihigugma ko kamo!

en: And no wonder, for Satan himself masquerades as an angel of light.
war: Diri ini orosahon! Kay bisan ngani hi Satanas nakakahimo hin pagpakita ha iya ngahaw sugad hin anghel han kapawa!

en: Since many are boasting in the way the world does, I too will boast.
war: Kundi tungod nga damo man in naparayaw hin kanan tawo la nga mga panuyo, bubuhaton ko man in sugad.

en: You gladly put up with fools since you are so wise!
war: Mga makinaadmananon gud man kamo, sanglit malipayon la kamo pagtugot hin mga lurong!

en: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they Abraham’s descendants? So am I.
war: Mga Hebreo ba hira? Sugad man ako. Mga Israelita ba hira? Sugad man ako. Mga tulin ba hira ni Abraham? Sugad man ako.

en: Five times I received from the Jews the forty lashes minus one.
war: Nakalima ako kumarawat han tag traynta y nuybe nga mga hampak han mga Judiyo;

en: Besides everything else, I face daily the pressure of my concern for all the churches.
war: Ngan waray labot han iba pa nga mga butang, nag-antos ako adlaw-adlaw hin kabaraka para han ngatanan nga mga singbahan.

en: Who is weak, and I do not feel weak? Who is led into sin, and I do not inwardly burn?
war: Kon may-ada maluya, naabat man ako hin kamaluya; kon may-ada nakakasala, napupuno ako hin kabidoan.

en: If I must boast, I will boast of the things that show my weakness.
war: Kon kinahanglan ako pumarayaw, ipaparayaw ko an mga butang nga nagpapakita han akon kamaluya.

en: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus, who is to be praised forever, knows that I am not lying.
war: Maaram an Dyos nga Amay han Ginoo nga Jesus nga diri ako nagbubuwa. Dayawon ha kadayonan an iya ngaran!

en: But I was lowered in a basket from a window in the wall and slipped through his hands.
war: Kundi gintunton ako sulod hin basket pinaagi hin buho dida han pader, ngan nakakalagiw ako.

en: Three times I pleaded with the Lord to take it away from me.
war: Nag-ampo ako ha Ginoo makatulo mahitungod hini, ngan naghangyo nga kuhaon ini.

en: Did I exploit you through any of the men I sent to you?
war: Ano ngani nga paagi? Sinmingabot ba ako ha iyo pinaagi han mga tawo nga akon ginsugo?

en: And I trust that you will discover that we have not failed the test.
war: Nasarig ako nga mahibabaro kamo nga waray kami mapakyas.

en: For we cannot do anything against the truth, but only for the truth.
war: Kay diri kami makakahimo hin bisan ano supak han kamatuoran, kundi para gudla han kamatuoran.

en: Greet one another with a holy kiss.
war: Magpangumostahay kamo hin minagburugto nga harok. Nangungumosta ha iyo an ngatanan nga mga magtinuohon han Dyos.

en: All God’s people here send their greetings.
war: An grasya han Ginoo Jesu-Cristo, an gugma han Dyos, ngan an pagkausa han Espiritu Santo maada unta ha iyo ngatanan!

en: because of the truth, which lives in us and will be with us forever:
war: kay magpapabilin ha aton an kamatuoran ngan mag-uupod ha aton ha kadayonan.

en: Anyone who welcomes them shares in their wicked work.
war: Kay an maghatag ha iya hin katalahoran, nahihimo nga kabulig han iya magraot nga mga buhat.

en: The children of your sister, who is chosen by God, send their greetings.
war: Nangungumosta ha imo an mga anak han imo hinigugma nga bugto nga babaye.

en: Grace and peace be yours in abundance through the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord.
war: Mapuno unta kamo han grasya ngan kamurayaw, pinaagi han iyo pagkilala han Dyos ngan kan Jesus nga aton Ginoo.

en: and to godliness, mutual affection; and to mutual affection, love.
war: ha iyo pagkadyosnon idugang an minagburugto nga pagbati, ngan ha iyo minaburugto nga pagbati idugang an paghigugma.

en: I think it is right to refresh your memory as long as I live in the tent of this body,
war: Natoo ako nga akon katungod hin pagpukaw han iyo panumdoman hiunong hini nga mga butang, samtang buhi pa ako.

en: We ourselves heard this voice that came from heaven when we were with him on the sacred mountain.
war: Hinbatian namon ngahaw ini nga tingog nga tikang ha langit, han upod kami niya dida han baraan nga bukid.

en: By these waters also the world of that time was deluged and destroyed.
war: ngan tubig liwat han Lunop an nagpuo han daan nga kalibutan.

en: But in keeping with his promise we are looking forward to a new heaven and a new earth, where righteousness dwells.
war: Kundi maghuhulat kita han iginsaad han Dyos: an bag-o nga kalangitan ngan bag-o nga tuna, diin naghahadi an pagkamatadong.

en: “Where have you come from?” David asked him. He answered, “I have escaped from the Israelite camp.”
war: Nagpakiana ha iya hi David, “Diin ka tikang?” “Nakakalagiw ako tikang han kampo han mga Israelita,” binmaton hiya.

en: When he turned around and saw me, he called out to me, and I said, ‘What can I do?’
war: Han paglingi niya, hinkit-an ako ngan gintawag ako niya. Binmaton ako, ‘Aadi ako!’

en: “He asked me, ‘Who are you?’ “ ‘An Amalekite,’ I answered.
war: Nagpakiana hiya kon hin-o ako, ngan ginsumatan ko hiya nga Amalekanhon ako.

en: David asked him, “Why weren’t you afraid to lift your hand to destroy the Lord ’s anointed?”
war: Nagpakiana ha iya hi David, “Ano an kasugad nga nagpasipara ka pagpatay han kanan Ginoo pinili nga hadi?”

en: David took up this lament concerning Saul and his son Jonathan,
war: Ginkanta ni David an iya kasubo tungod kan Saul ngan han iya anak hi Jonatan,

en: and he ordered that the people of Judah be taught this lament of the bow (it is written in the Book of Jashar):
war: ngan nagsugo hiya nga igtutdo ini ha mga tawo han Juda. (Nahisurat ini dida han An Basahan ni Jasar .)

en: The length of time David was king in Hebron over Judah was seven years and six months.
war: ngan naghadi hiya han Juda didto ha Hebron hin pito hin tunga ka tuig.

en: Abner son of Ner, together with the men of Ish-Bosheth son of Saul, left Mahanaim and went to Gibeon.
war: Tikang ha Mahanaim kinmadto han syudad han Gabaon hi Abner ngan an mga opisyal ni Isboset.

en: He chased Abner, turning neither to the right nor to the left as he pursued him.
war: Ginlanat niya hi Abner.

en: Abner looked behind him and asked, “Is that you, Asahel?” “It is,” he answered.
war: Linmingi hi Abner ngan nagsiring, “Amo ka ba hi Asahel?” “Oo,” binmaton hiya.

en: So Joab blew the trumpet, and all the troops came to a halt; they no longer pursued Israel, nor did they fight anymore.
war: Niyan nagtrompeta hi Joab pagpahunong na han iya mga tawo hin paglanat han mga Israelita; sanglit inmundang an araway.

en: But David’s men had killed three hundred and sixty Benjamites who were with Abner.
war: Nakamatay an mga tawo ni David hin 360 han kan Abner mga tawo nga sakop han tribo ni Benjamin.

en: the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith; the fifth, Shephatiah the son of Abital;
war: hi Adonias nga anak ni Haguit; hi Sefatias nga anak ni Abital;

en: and the sixth, Ithream the son of David’s wife Eglah. These were born to David in Hebron.
war: hi Itream nga anak ni Egla. Ini ngatanan mga anak ni David ngan didto hira ngatanan natawo ha Hebron.

en: Ish-Bosheth did not dare to say another word to Abner, because he was afraid of him.
war: Duro gud an kahadlok ni Isboset kan Abner nga waray hiya makayakan bisan usa ka pulong.

en: So Ish-Bosheth gave orders and had her taken away from her husband Paltiel son of Laish.
war: Sanglit iginpakuha ni Isboset hi Mical tikang han iya bana nga hi Paltiel nga anak ni Lais.

en: The king sang this lament for Abner: “Should Abner have died as the lawless die?
war: Ginkanta ni David ini nga pagnguyngoy para kan Abner: “Kinahanglan mamatay ba hi Abner sugad hin lurong?

en: because the people of Beeroth fled to Gittaim and have resided there as foreigners to this day.
war: Nangalagiw ngadto ha Gitaim an tinuod nga mga umurokoy han Beerot, diin nag-ukoy hira tikang pa hadto.)

en: David was thirty years old when he became king, and he reigned forty years.
war: Hi David 30 na an panuigon han kahimo niya nga hadi, ngan naghadi hiya hin 40 ka tuig.

en: Nevertheless, David captured the fortress of Zion—which is the City of David.
war: Kundi nabihag ni David an ira madig-on nga kota han Sion, ngan ginkilala ini nga “Syudad ni David.”)

en: And he became more and more powerful, because the Lord God Almighty was with him.
war: Nagtikakusog la hi David, kay nakada ha iya an Ginoo nga Dyos nga Labi Kamakagarahum.

en: These are the names of the children born to him there: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,
war: Amo ini an mga anak nga natawo didto ha Jerusalem: hira Samua, Sobab, Natan, Solomon,

en: Ibhar, Elishua, Nepheg, Japhia,
war: Ibaar, Elisua, Nefeg, Jafia,

en: Elishama, Eliada and Eliphelet.
war: Elisama, Eliada, ug Elifelet.

en: Now the Philistines had come and spread out in the Valley of Rephaim;
war: Nagkaabot ngadto ha Kahamub-an han Refaim an mga Filisteohanon ngan ginrikopohan ini.

en: Once more the Philistines came up and spread out in the Valley of Rephaim;
war: Niyan binmalik ngadto ha Kahamub-an han Refaim an mga Filisteohanon ngan ginrikopohan na liwat ini.

en: David again brought together all the able young men of Israel—thirty thousand.
war: Gintirok na liwat ni David an gimamag-upayi nga mga sondalo didto ha Israel, nga inmabot ngatanan hin 30,000 nga kalalaken-an,

en: with the ark of God on it, and Ahio was walking in front of it.
war: nga nag-uuna han karomata hi Ahio.

en: Wearing a linen ephod, David was dancing before the Lord with all his might,
war: Nagsinayaw hi David, tugob hin kalipay, ha pagpasidungog han Ginoo , nga nakakatapis la hiya hin dugnit nga lino.

en: And Michal daughter of Saul had no children to the day of her death.
war: Waray gud mag-anak hi Mical nga anak ni Saul, asta nga namatay.

en: Nathan replied to the king, “Whatever you have in mind, go ahead and do it, for the Lord is with you.”
war: Binmaton hi Natan, “Buhata an imo ginhuhunahuna, kay aada ha imo an Ginoo .”

en: But that night the word of the Lord came to Nathan, saying:
war: Kundi hito nga gab-i nagsiring an Ginoo kan Natan,

en: He is the one who will build a house for my Name, and I will establish the throne of his kingdom forever.
war: Hiya amo an magtitindog hin templo para ha akon, ngan tatalinguhaon ko nga maghadi an iya katulinan ha kadayonan.

en: Nathan reported to David all the words of this entire revelation.
war: Iginsumat ni Natan kan David an ngatanan nga iginpadayag ha iya han Dyos.

en: “What more can David say to you? For you know your servant, Sovereign Lord .
war: Ano pa in akon igsisiring ha imo! Nakilala ka ha akon nga imo surugoon.

en: David took the gold shields that belonged to the officers of Hadadezer and brought them to Jerusalem.
war: Gin-agaw ni David an bulawan nga mga taming nga dara han mga opisyal ni Hadadeser ngadto ha Jerusalem.

en: From Tebah and Berothai, towns that belonged to Hadadezer, King David took a great quantity of bronze.
war: Ginkuha liwat niya in kadam-an nga mga bronse tikang ha Beta ug Berotai nga mga syudad nga ginhahadian ni Hadadeser.

en: When Tou king of Hamath heard that David had defeated the entire army of Hadadezer,
war: Hinbatian ni Hadi Toi han Hamat nga ginpirde ni David an ngatanan nga kasondalohan ni Hadadeser.

en: Zadok son of Ahitub and Ahimelek son of Abiathar were priests; Seraiah was secretary;
war: hira Sadoc nga anak ni Ahitob ngan hi Ahimelec nga anak ni Abiatar amo an kapadian; hi Seraias amo an sekretaryo han korte;

en: So King David had him brought from Lo Debar, from the house of Makir son of Ammiel.
war: Sanglit iginpakuha ini nga tawo ni Hadi David.

en: And Mephibosheth lived in Jerusalem, because he always ate at the king’s table; he was lame in both feet.
war: Sanglit nag-ukoy didto ha Jerusalem hi Mefiboset nga piay an duha nga tiil, nga dayuday kasaro han hadi.

en: In the course of time, the king of the Ammonites died, and his son Hanun succeeded him as king.
war: Waray kaiha namatay hi Hadi Nahas han Amon ngan hi Hanun nga iya anak an naghadi.

en: On hearing this, David sent Joab out with the entire army of fighting men.
war: Hinbaroan ini ni David ngan ginsugo niya hi Joab hin pagsulong ha ira upod an ngatanan nga kasondalohan.

en: Then Joab and the troops with him advanced to fight the Arameans, and they fled before him.
war: Sinmulong hin pakig-away hi Joab ngan an iya mga tawo, ngan nangalagiw an mga Siriahanon.

en: After the Arameans saw that they had been routed by Israel, they regrouped.
war: Han pakakita han mga Siriahanon nga ginpirde na hira han mga Israelita, gintirok nira an ngatanan nira nga kasondalohan.

en: The woman conceived and sent word to David, saying, “I am pregnant.”
war: Waray kaiha nakasabot hiya nga burod na hiya ngan ginsumatan niya hi David.

en: In the morning David wrote a letter to Joab and sent it with Uriah.
war: Han pagkaaga nagsurat hi David kan Joab ngan iginpadara ini kan Urias.

en: Joab sent David a full account of the battle.
war: Niyan nagpadara hi Joab ngadto kan David hin sumat hiunong han away,

en: He instructed the messenger: “When you have finished giving the king this account of the battle,
war: ngan iya gintugon an sinugo, “Katapos mo pagsumati kan David han ngatanan hiunong han araway,

en: The messenger set out, and when he arrived he told David everything Joab had sent him to say.
war: Sanglit kinmadto kan David an sinugo ngan ginsumatan niya hi David han iginsugo ha iya ni Joab.

en: When Uriah’s wife heard that her husband was dead, she mourned for him.
war: Han paghibaro la ni Batseba nga namatay na an iya bana, nagmasulob-on hiya tungod han iya bana.

en: The rich man had a very large number of sheep and cattle,
war: Damo an mga baka ngan mga karnero han riko,

en: He must pay for that lamb four times over, because he did such a thing and had no pity.”
war: Kinahanglan pagbaydan niya hin upat ka pilo an iya kinuha, tungod han pagbuhat niya hin sugad kamabangis nga butang.”

en: You did it in secret, but I will do this thing in broad daylight before all Israel.’ ”
war: Imo ini gintago nga sala, kundi ipabubuhat ko ini ha kapaw-an han adlaw, ha atubangan han bug-os nga Israel.’”

en: Meanwhile Joab fought against Rabbah of the Ammonites and captured the royal citadel.
war: Nagpadayon hi Joab pakig-away kontra han Raba nga kapital nga syudad han Amon, ngan gutiay na gud la marikopo ini.

en: So David mustered the entire army and went to Rabbah, and attacked and captured it.
war: Sanglit gintirok ni David an iya kasondalohan, kinmadto ha Raba, ginsulong, ngan nakuha niya an syudad.

en: But he refused to listen to her, and since he was stronger than she, he raped her.
war: Kundi waray la hiya mamati kan Tamar; ngan tungod nga makurukusog man hi Amnon ha iya, linupigan ngan ginlugos hiya.

en: When King David heard all this, he was furious.
war: Han paghibaroi ni David han nahinabo, napungot hiya hin duro.

en: Joab son of Zeruiah knew that the king’s heart longed for Absalom.
war: Hinbaroan ni Joab nga anak ni Seruia nga nahihidlaw hin duro hi Hadi David kan Absalon,

en: Then go to the king and speak these words to him.” And Joab put the words in her mouth.
war: Niyan kadtoa an hadi ngan sidnga hiya han akon igsisiring ha imo.” Katapos ginsumatan hiya ni Joab han iya igyayakan han hadi.

en: The king said to the woman, “Go home, and I will issue an order in your behalf.”
war: Binmaton an hadi, “Uli nala, ngan akon ini paninimangnoon.”

en: Then Joab went to Geshur and brought Absalom back to Jerusalem.
war: Niyan binmuhat hiya ngan kinmadto ha Gesur, ngan iginbalik hi Absalon ngadto ha Jerusalem.

en: Three sons and a daughter were born to Absalom. His daughter’s name was Tamar, and she became a beautiful woman.
war: May tulo nga mga anak nga kalalaken-an hi Absalon, ngan usa nga babaye nga ginngaranan kan Tamar, mahusay hin duro nga babaye.

en: Absalom lived two years in Jerusalem without seeing the king’s face.
war: Nag-ukoy hi Absalon hin duha ka tuig didto ha Jerusalem ngan waray hiya igkakita han hadi.

en: The king said to him, “Go in peace.” So he went to Hebron.
war: “Maupay na la nga imo paglakat,” nagsiring an hadi. Sanglit kinmadto ha Hebron hi Absalon.

en: So the king set out, with all the people following him, and they halted at the edge of the city.
war: Han nabaya na han syudad an hadi ngan an ngatanan nga iya mga tawo, hinmapit hira dida han kataposan nga balay.

en: So Zadok and Abiathar took the ark of God back to Jerusalem and stayed there.
war: Sanglit iginbalik ngadto ha Jerusalem nira Sadoc ug Abiatar an Kahon han Ginsaaran ngan nagpabilin hira didto.

en: David said to him, “If you go with me, you will be a burden to me.
war: Nagsiring ha iya hi David, “Diri ka makakabulig ha akon kon umupod ka ha akon,

en: So Hushai, David’s confidant, arrived at Jerusalem as Absalom was entering the city.
war: Sanglit binmalik ngadto han syudad hi Husai nga sangkay ni David, dida han tisakob na hi Absalon han syudad.

en: The king and all the people with him arrived at their destination exhausted. And there he refreshed himself.
war: Kinapoy hin duro hi David ngan an ngatanan niya nga mga tawo han pag-abot nira han Jordan, ngan pinmahuway hira didto.

en: Meanwhile, Absalom and all the men of Israel came to Jerusalem, and Ahithophel was with him.
war: Sinmulod ha Jerusalem hi Absalon ngan an ngatanan nga mga Israelita nga tinmampo ha iya, ngan upod nira hi Ahitofel.

en: Absalom said to Ahithophel, “Give us your advice. What should we do?”
war: Niyan inatubang ni Absalon hi Ahitofel ngan ginsiring, “Yana nga aanhi na kita, ano an imo sadang isagdon ha akon?”

en: This plan seemed good to Absalom and to all the elders of Israel.
war: Daw nakalipay ini nga sagdon kan Absalon ngan han ngatanan nga mga punoan nga Israelita.

en: But Absalom said, “Summon also Hushai the Arkite, so we can hear what he has to say as well.”
war: Nagsiring hi Absalon, “Tawaga liwat hi Husai, ngan pamatii ta kon ano man an iya igsisiring.”

en: Hushai replied to Absalom, “The advice Ahithophel has given is not good this time.
war: Binmaton hi Husai, “Diri maupay an iginsagdon ha iyo yana ni Ahitofel.

en: David went to Mahanaim, and Absalom crossed the Jordan with all the men of Israel.
war: Nakadto na hi David han bungto han Mahanaim han pakatabok han Jordan ni Absalon ngan han iya mga tawo. (

en: The Israelites and Absalom camped in the land of Gilead.
war: Nagkampo didto han tuna han Galaad hi Absalon ngan an iya mga tawo.

en: David’s army marched out of the city to fight Israel, and the battle took place in the forest of Ephraim.
war: Ginmawas ngadto han kapatagan an kasondalohan ni David ngan pinakiawayan an mga Israelita didto ha Kagurangan han Efraim.

en: And ten of Joab’s armor-bearers surrounded Absalom, struck him and killed him.
war: Niyan dinmaop kan Absalon in napulo han mga sondalo ni Joab, ngan ginhuman nira an pagpatay kan Absalon.

en: The king said, “Stand aside and wait here.” So he stepped aside and stood there.
war: “Tukdaw anay didto,” ginsiring hiya han hadi, sanglit kinmadto hiya ngan hinmulat.

en: Joab was told, “The king is weeping and mourning for Absalom.”
war: Ginsumatan hi Joab nga nagtangis ngan nagmabidoon tungod kan Absalon hi Hadi David.

en: So the king said to Shimei, “You shall not die.” And the king promised him on oath.
war: Ngan nagsiring hiya kan Simei, “Nagsusumpa ako ha imo nga diri ka papatayon.”

en: The king said to Barzillai, “Cross over with me and stay with me in Jerusalem, and I will provide for you.”
war: Nagsiring ha iya an hadi, “Upod ha akon ngadto ha Jerusalem ngan pagmamangnoan ko ikaw.”

en: But when Amasa went to summon Judah, he took longer than the time the king had set for him.
war: Linmakat hi Amasa hin pagtirok ha ira, kundi waray hira bumalik han adlaw nga igintalaan han hadi.

en: “Far be it from me!” Joab replied, “Far be it from me to swallow up or destroy!
war: “Diri gud,” binmaton hi Joab. “Diri gud ako magruruba o magbubungkag han iyo syudad!

en: Adoniram was in charge of forced labor; Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was recorder;
war: hi Adoram amo an tinaporan han inoripon nga trabaho; hi Josafat nga anak ni Ahilud amo an tinaporan han mga sinurat;

en: Sheva was secretary; Zadok and Abiathar were priests;
war: hi Seva amo an sekretaryo han palasyo; hira Sadoc ug Abiatar amo an mga padi,

en: and Ira the Jairite was David’s priest.
war: ngan usa liwat han kan David kapadian amo hi Ira nga taga bungto han Jair.

en: When David was told what Aiah’s daughter Rizpah, Saul’s concubine, had done,
war: Han paghibaroi ni David han ginbuhat ni Rizpa,

en: When he taunted Israel, Jonathan son of Shimeah, David’s brother, killed him.
war: Gin-ayat niya an mga Israelita ngan ginpatay hiya ni Jonatan nga anak ni Sama nga bugto ni David.

en: He said: “The Lord is my rock, my fortress and my deliverer;
war: Akon bato, akon kota an Ginoo ngan hiya ha akon nagbawi.

en: “I called to the Lord , who is worthy of praise, and have been saved from my enemies.
war: Natawag ako han Ginoo , takos hiya han akon pagdayeg. Ginggawas ako ha mga kasamokan.

en: The waves of death swirled about me; the torrents of destruction overwhelmed me.
war: An mga balod han kamatayon nakalumos ha akon. An mga baha han akon kapukan nakadaog ha akon.

en: The cords of the grave coiled around me; the snares of death confronted me.
war: An mga pisi han kamatayon nakahikog ha akon. An mga bitik han kamatayon nakapalisang ha akon.

en: The earth trembled and quaked, the foundations of the heavens shook; they trembled because he was angry.
war: Nabay-og ug nangurog an tuna; nabantad an patukoranan han langit. Kinmurog kay nasina hiya.

en: He parted the heavens and came down; dark clouds were under his feet.
war: Binuksan niya an kalangitan, ngan tuna an iya linusaran, upod in mga dampog nga maitom ha iya mga tiil nailarom.

en: He mounted the cherubim and flew; he soared on the wings of the wind.
war: An anghel an iya sinasakyan, hataas an iya linolupdan. Masukot hiya hikit-an, ha bawbaw han kahanginan.

en: He made darkness his canopy around him— the dark rain clouds of the sky.
war: Tabon niya an kasisidman, mga dampog hin tubig hiya ginugup-an.

en: Out of the brightness of his presence bolts of lightning blazed forth.
war: Mga baga nga naglalahinggab, hin kalayo naulyab.

en: The Lord thundered from heaven; the voice of the Most High resounded.
war: An Ginoo ginmoliat ha kalangitan, han Gihahataasi in tingog hinbatian.

en: He shot his arrows and scattered the enemy, with great bolts of lightning he routed them.
war: Tungod han iya pana hira nagsarang, han kikidlat hira nanadlagan.

en: “He reached down from on high and took hold of me; he drew me out of deep waters.
war: Ginggawad ako niya ngan ginggawas ha katubigan ngan ako natalwas.

en: He rescued me from my powerful enemy, from my foes, who were too strong for me.
war: Tikang han mga kaaway gintalwas ako han mga nagdudumot nga mga tawo. Waray ako makaato, kay makusog hira hin duro.

en: They confronted me in the day of my disaster, but the Lord was my support.
war: Ginsulong ako takna nga kakurian, kundi han Ginoo ako ginsalipdan.

en: He brought me out into a spacious place; he rescued me because he delighted in me.
war: Gin-agaw ako niya ha kataragman; tungod kay ako iya nalilipayan.

en: “The Lord has dealt with me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands he has rewarded me.
war: An Ginoo nabalos kay ako matadong; ginpakaupay ako kay di' masupakon.

en: For I have kept the ways of the Lord ; I am not guilty of turning from my God.
war: Balaod han Ginoo ako masugtanon, han Dyos di' ako masinupilon.

en: All his laws are before me; I have not turned away from his decrees.
war: Gintuman ko an mga balaod niya, iya mga sugo waray ko pagsupaka.

en: I have been blameless before him and have kept myself from sin.
war: Maaram gud hiya nga diri ako salaan, nga nadiri ako pagbuhat hin karat-an.

en: The Lord has rewarded me according to my righteousness, according to my cleanness in his sight.
war: Sanglit nabalos kay ako matadong, sayod hiya nga diri ako masupakon.

en: to the pure you show yourself pure, but to the devious you show yourself shrewd.
war: Maputli ka hadton putli ha hunahuna, ngan maisog ka hadton makasasala.

en: You save the humble, but your eyes are on the haughty to bring them low.
war: Gintatalwas mo an mapinaubsanon, ginpapaubos an mapinahitas-on.

en: You, Lord , are my lamp; the Lord turns my darkness into light.
war: Ikaw, O Ginoo , an akon kapawa; an kasisidman ko imo pinapara.

en: With your help I can advance against a troop ; with my God I can scale a wall.
war: Kusog hin pakiaway ha akon imo hinatag, ngan gahom hin mga panalipod pagbungkag.

en: For who is God besides the Lord ? And who is the Rock except our God?
war: An Ginoo gudla an Dyos, hin-o pa man? An Dyos gudla amo an aton darangpan.

en: It is God who arms me with strength and keeps my way secure.
war: Ini nga Dyos madig-on ko nga arayopan, an akon dalan nga waray kataragman.

en: He makes my feet like the feet of a deer; he causes me to stand on the heights.
war: Diri magsasayop an akon mga pitad, sugad han bugsok ha bukid paglakat.

en: He trains my hands for battle; my arms can bend a bow of bronze.
war: Hin pag-away iya ako gintutdoan, hin pagpana akon gin-adman.

en: You make your saving help my shield; your help has made me great.
war: O Ginoo , imo ako ginpanalipdan; Han imo tambulig ako nagamhanan.

en: You provide a broad path for my feet, so that my ankles do not give way.
war: Waray mo itugot nga ako mabihag, nga ako mapukan, ha imo mahibulag.

en: “I pursued my enemies and crushed them; I did not turn back till they were destroyed.
war: Ginlanat, ginpirde an kaaway nakon; ha ira pagbungkag waray ako humunong.

en: I crushed them completely, and they could not rise; they fell beneath my feet.
war: Gintumba ko hira, diri na mabangon; tumba nga pirdedo ha tiilan nakon.

en: You armed me with strength for battle; you humbled my adversaries before me.
war: Hatag ha akon kusog ha pag-awayan, Ha akon kaaway, akon pagdarag-an.

en: You made my enemies turn their backs in flight, and I destroyed my foes.
war: Mga kaaway ko pinalagiw ha akon; an nagdumot ha akon maupay pagpuohon.

en: They cried for help, but there was no one to save them— to the Lord , but he did not answer.
war: Hin tambulig hira nangingita, kundi waray nakakatalwas ha ira. Han Ginoo hira nangaraba, kundi waray hira niya batona.

en: I beat them as fine as the dust of the earth; I pounded and trampled them like mud in the streets.
war: Akon gindudugmok hira ngatanan, tapotapo an ira dinangatan. Akon hira gintatamaktamakan, sugad hin lapok ha kadalanan.

en: foreigners cower before me; as soon as they hear of me, they obey me.
war: Mga lumalangyaw ha akon nahapa, nasugot gud dayon kon nabati hira.

en: They all lose heart; they come trembling from their strongholds.
war: Nangurog hin kahadlok mga lumalangyaw, paggawas ha kota, kay hira nagtalaw.

en: He is the God who avenges me, who puts the nations under me,
war: Akon pagdarag-an iya ginhatag, akon kaaway iya ginbihag. Akon nasakop an mga tawo,

en: “The Spirit of the Lord spoke through me; his word was on my tongue.
war: Naghihimangraw pinaagi ha akon an Espiritu han Ginoo ; aanhi han akon mga im-im an iya mensahe.

en: Was he not held in greater honor than the Three? He became their commander, even though he was not included among them.
war: Hiya an labi kabantogan han “An Traynta,” ngan nahimo nga ira pangulo, kundi diri hiya sugad kabantogan han “An Tutulo.”

en: So David went up, as the Lord had commanded through Gad.
war: Gintuman ni David an sugo han Ginoo ngan kinmadto hiya sumala han iginsiring ha iya ni Gad.

en: Grace and peace to you from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
war: Tagan unta kamo han Dyos Amay ngan han Ginoo Jesu-Cristo han grasya ngan kamurayaw.

en: God is just: He will pay back trouble to those who trouble you
war: Bubuhaton han Dyos an matadong: papapag-antoson niya an mga nagpapaantos ha iyo,

en: Don’t you remember that when I was with you I used to tell you these things?
war: Diri ba kamo nahinunumdom? Ginsumatan ko kamo hini ngatanan samtang nakada pa ako ha iyo.

en: For this reason God sends them a powerful delusion so that they will believe the lie
war: Tungod hini itinugot han Dyos nga kalimbongan hira ngan tumoo hira han mga buwa,

en: and so that all will be condemned who have not believed the truth but have delighted in wickedness.
war: basi paghukman ha karat-an an ngatanan nga waray tumoo han kamatuoran, kundi nagpatakas la hin pagpinakasala.

en: But the Lord is faithful, and he will strengthen you and protect you from the evil one.
war: Kundi katataporan an Ginoo. Paririg-unon kamo niya ngan pananalipdan kamo han mga karat-an han Yawa.

en: May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love and Christ’s perseverance.
war: Hinaot unta nga bantaron han Ginoo an iyo mga kasingkasing hin paghigugma han Dyos, ngan hin pag-ilob nga ginhatag ni Cristo.

en: For you yourselves know how you ought to follow our example. We were not idle when we were with you,
war: Maaram kamo ngahaw nga kinahanglan niyo buhaton an amon ginbuhat. Diri kami mga hubya han nakada pa kami ha iyo.

en: And as for you, brothers and sisters, never tire of doing what is good.
war: Kundi, kabugtoan, kinahanglan diri kamo gul-an hin pagbuhat han maupay.

en: Yet do not regard them as an enemy, but warn them as you would a fellow believer.
war: Kundi ayaw isipa hiya nga kaaway; lugod, sagdoni hiya sugad hin usa nga bugto.

en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all.
war: Maada unta ha iyo ngatanan an grasya han aton Ginoo Jesu-Cristo.

en: Recalling your tears, I long to see you, so that I may be filled with joy.
war: Nahinunumdom ako han imo mga luha, ngan karuyag ko gud makigkita ha imo, basi magmalipayon ako.

en: And of this gospel I was appointed a herald and an apostle and a teacher.
war: Gintungdan ako han Dyos hin pagsangyaw han Maupay nga Sumat sugad nga apostol ngan magturutdo,

en: Guard the good deposit that was entrusted to you—guard it with the help of the Holy Spirit who lives in us.
war: Tipigi an mag-upay nga mga butang nga igintapod ha imo, pinaagi han gahom han Espiritu Santo nga nag-uukoy dinhe ha aton.

en: You know that everyone in the province of Asia has deserted me, including Phygelus and Hermogenes.
war: Maaram ka nga hira ngatanan didto ha lalawigan han Asia, upod hira Figelo ug Hermogenes tinmalikod ha akon.

en: On the contrary, when he was in Rome, he searched hard for me until he found me.
war: kundi han pag-abot niya ha Roma, ginpinamiling ako niya dayon tubtob nga hin-agian ako niya.

en: You then, my son, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
war: Mahitungod ha imo, anak ko, pagmakusog pinaagi han gahom nga naangkon ta dida ha pakig-usa kan Cristo Jesus.

en: Join with me in suffering, like a good soldier of Christ Jesus.
war: Pakig-angbit hin pag-antos sugad hin mainugopon nga sondalo ni Cristo Jesus.

en: Similarly, anyone who competes as an athlete does not receive the victor’s crown except by competing according to the rules.
war: Adton nadalagan dida hin paisan-isan diri man makakadaog han primyo, gawas kon sundon niya an mga turumanon han uyag.

en: The hardworking farmer should be the first to receive a share of the crops.
war: An parauma nga nagkabudlay hin dako kinahanglan amo an makaangkon han syahan nga bahin han inani.

en: Reflect on what I am saying, for the Lord will give you insight into all this.
war: Paghunahunaa kon ano an karuyag ko sidngon, kay an Ginoo mabulig ha imo hin pakasabot han ngatanan nga mga butang.

en: Remember Jesus Christ, raised from the dead, descended from David. This is my gospel,
war: Hinumdomi hi Jesu-Cristo nga tulin ni David, nga ginbanhaw, sumala han Maupay nga Sumat nga akon iginwali.

en: Here is a trustworthy saying: If we died with him, we will also live with him;
war: Matuod ini nga darahunon: “Kon mamatay kita upod ha iya, mabubuhi man kita upod ha iya.

en: if we endure, we will also reign with him. If we disown him, he will also disown us;
war: Kon magpadayon kita hin pag-ilob, maghahadi man kita upod ha iya. Kon iglirong ta hiya, iglilirong man kita niya.

en: if we are faithless, he remains faithful, for he cannot disown himself.
war: Kon diri kita magmatinumanon, nagpapadayon gihapon hiya kamatinumanon, kay diri hiya matipa han iya kalugaringon.”

en: Avoid godless chatter, because those who indulge in it will become more and more ungodly.
war: Likayi an diri dyosnon nga linurong nga mga larolantugi, nakakapahirayo sa Dyos han mga tawo.

en: Their teaching will spread like gangrene. Among them are Hymenaeus and Philetus,
war: An ira igintututdo nasusugad hin kapithok nga nagkukutkot han unod. Duha ini nga mga magturutdo amo hira Himeneo ug Fileto.

en: And the Lord’s servant must not be quarrelsome but must be kind to everyone, able to teach, not resentful.
war: An surugoon han Ginoo kinahanglan diri makig-away. Kinahanglan maloloy-on hiya ha ngatanan, maupay ngan mailobon nga magturutdo,

en: But mark this: There will be terrible times in the last days.
war: Tigamni ini! Magmamakuri an panahon ha kataposan nga mga adlaw.

en: treacherous, rash, conceited, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God—
war: magmamalingo hira, magpapasagad la hira ngan malabyaw asay lugod nira hihigugmaon an kalipayan, diri an Dyos;

en: having a form of godliness but denying its power. Have nothing to do with such people.
war: magpapakita hira nga daw mainampoon, kundi ira isasalikway an tinuod nga gahom han tuloohan. Pahirayo hini nga mga tawo.

en: always learning but never able to come to a knowledge of the truth.
war: kababayen-an nga dayuday nagtitinguha pag-aram, kundi diri gud nakakasabot han kamatuoran.

en: In fact, everyone who wants to live a godly life in Christ Jesus will be persecuted,
war: Pagpapakurian manta an ngatanan nga karuyag mag-ukoy hin dyosnon nga kinabuhi dida ha pakig-usa kan Cristo Jesus;

en: while evildoers and impostors will go from bad to worse, deceiving and being deceived.
war: kundi an magraot nga mga tawo magpapadayon hin paghingaraot, maglilimbong hira han iba, ngan kalilimbongan man liwat hira.

en: so that the servant of God may be thoroughly equipped for every good work.
war: basi an tawo nga nag-aalagad han Dyos matakos ngan masangkap hin hingpit nga pagtuman han ngatanan nga mag-upay nga mga buhat.

en: They will turn their ears away from the truth and turn aside to myths.
war: Magpapakabungol hira han kamatuoran, ngan asay lugod nira pamamatian an hinimohimo nga mga susumaton.

en: For I am already being poured out like a drink offering, and the time for my departure is near.
war: An para ha akon, inmabot na an takna hin paghalad han akon kalugaringon, aanhi na an panahon nga mabaya ako hini nga kinabuhi.

en: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith.
war: Ginbuhat ko tubtob han akon maabot dida han paisan-isan, ngan natapos ko gud ini, gintipigan ko an pagtoo.

en: Do your best to come to me quickly,
war: Talinguhaa gud nga magdali ka hin pagkadi ha akon.

en: I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.
war: Ginpakadto ko ha Efeso hi Tiquico.

en: You too should be on your guard against him, because he strongly opposed our message.
war: Paghirot liwat kamo ha iya kay natipa gud hiya han aton mensahe.

en: Greet Priscilla and Aquila and the household of Onesiphorus.
war: Nangungumosta ako kanda Priscila ug Aquila, ngan han panimalay ni Onesiforo.

en: Erastus stayed in Corinth, and I left Trophimus sick in Miletus.
war: Nagpabilin ha Corinto hi Erasto, ngan iginbilin ko ha Mileto hi Trofimo, kay nasakit hiya.

en: The Lord be with your spirit. Grace be with you all.
war: An Ginoo maada unta ha iyo. An grasya han Dyos maada ha iyo ngatanan.

en: The elder, To my dear friend Gaius, whom I love in the truth.
war: Tikang han usa nga Tigurang han singbahan— Ngadto han akon minahal nga Gayo nga hinigugma ko hin tinuod.

en: I have no greater joy than to hear that my children are walking in the truth.
war: Waray na labaw nga nakakalipay ha akon kay hin pakabati nga an akon mga anak nag-uokoy dida han kamatuoran.

en: It was for the sake of the Name that they went out, receiving no help from the pagans.
war: An tuyo han ira paglakaton amo an pag-alagad kan Cristo, ngan waray kumarawat hin bulig tikang han diri mga magtinuohon.

en: We ought therefore to show hospitality to such people so that we may work together for the truth.
war: Sanglit, an mga Cristianos kinahanglan bumulig hini nga mga tawo, basi makaangbit kita han ira buruhaton para han kamatuoran.

en: I have much to write you, but I do not want to do so with pen and ink.
war: Damo pa an akon isurumat ha imo, kundi gabay ko diri ipaagi hin pagsurat.

en: I hope to see you soon, and we will talk face to face.
war: Naglalaom ako hin pakigkita dayon ha imo, ngan maghihimangraw na la kita nga duha.

en: He was one of our number and shared in our ministry.”
war: Kaapi ini hi Judas han amon hugpo, kay ginpili hiya nga kabahin han amon buruhaton.” (

en: So they nominated two men: Joseph called Barsabbas (also known as Justus) and Matthias.
war: Sanglit igintuboy nira in duha nga lalake: hi Jose nga an ngaran Barsabas (gintawag liwat nga Justo), ngan hi Matias.

en: to take over this apostolic ministry, which Judas left to go where he belongs.”
war: nga masaliwan kan Judas hin pagka-apostol nga binayaan niya han pagkadto niya han dapit nga angay ha iya.”

en: Then they cast lots, and the lot fell to Matthias; so he was added to the eleven apostles.
war: Katapos ginripa nira an duha nga mga ngaran, ngan hi Matias amo an napili. Igindugang hiya han hugpo han onse nga mga apostoles.

en: When the day of Pentecost came, they were all together in one place.
war: Han pag-abot na han adlaw han Pentecostes, nagkatitirok an ngatanan nga mga magtinuohon ha usa nga dapit.

en: They saw what seemed to be tongues of fire that separated and came to rest on each of them.
war: Ngan nakakita hira hin sugad hin mga dila nga kalayo nga hinmugdon ha kada usa ha ira.

en: Now there were staying in Jerusalem God-fearing Jews from every nation under heaven.
war: Nag-uokoy didto ha Jerusalem in mga Judiyo nga mag-inampoon, mga tawo nga tikang ha magkalainlain nga mga nasod han kalibutan.

en: Utterly amazed, they asked: “Aren’t all these who are speaking Galileans?
war: Nagsiring hira ha dako nga paghipausa, “Diri ba mga taga-Galilea ini ngatanan nga nagyayakan?

en: Then how is it that each of us hears them in our native language?
war: Naunan-o man nga nakabati kita ngatanan ha ira nga nagyayakan han aton tagsa nga kalugaringon nga yinaknan?

en: Amazed and perplexed, they asked one another, “What does this mean?”
war: Ha ira paghipausa ngan kagupong, naggiparopakiana hira, “Ano ba an karuyag sidngon hini?”

en: Some, however, made fun of them and said, “They have had too much wine.”
war: Kundi an mga magtinuohon gin-intrimisan han iba ha ira ngan nagsiring, “Mga hubog ini nga mga tawo!”

en: These people are not drunk, as you suppose. It’s only nine in the morning!
war: Diri hubog ini nga mga tawo sugad han iyo paghunahuna, kay alas nuybe pa la ha aga yana.

en: No, this is what was spoken by the prophet Joel:
war: Kundi amo ini an iginsiring han manaragna nga hi Joel:

en: And everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.’
war: Ngan onina matatalwas an bisan hin-o nga magsangpit han Ginoo hin pakibulig.’

en: You have made known to me the paths of life; you will fill me with joy in your presence.’
war: Iginpakita mo ha akon an mga agianan tipakadto ha kinabuhi; ngan magpupuno ha akon hin kalipay an imo pakig-usa ha akon.’

en: God has raised this Jesus to life, and we are all witnesses of it.
war: Ginbanhaw han Dyos ini ngahaw nga Jesus, ngan mga saksi kami hini ngatanan.

en: until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet.” ’
war: tubtob nga himoon ko an imo mga kaaway nga taramakan han imo mga tiil.’

en: Those who accepted his message were baptized, and about three thousand were added to their number that day.
war: Damo ha ira in tinmoo han iya mensahe ngan ginbunyagan hira. Mga 3,000 nga mga tawo an nahidugang han hugpo hito nga adlaw.

en: Everyone was filled with awe at the many wonders and signs performed by the apostles.
war: Ginbuhat in damo nga mga milagro ngan mga urosahon pinaagi han mga apostoles ngan nakapatingala ini han ngatanan.

en: One day Peter and John were going up to the temple at the time of prayer—at three in the afternoon.
war: Usa ka adlaw kinmadto ha Templo hira Pedro ug Juan alas tres ha kulop, an takna han pag-ampo.

en: When he saw Peter and John about to enter, he asked them for money.
war: Han pakakita niya kanda Pedro ug Juan nga nasulod, nakilimos hiya ha ira.

en: Peter looked straight at him, as did John. Then Peter said, “Look at us!”
war: Tinutokan hiya nira ngan nagsiring hi Pedro, “Siplat ha amon!”

en: So the man gave them his attention, expecting to get something from them.
war: Sanglit sinmiplat hiya ha ira nga naglalaom nga lilimosan hiya.

en: When all the people saw him walking and praising God,
war: An ngatanan nakakita ha iya nga naglalakat ngan nagdadayaw han Dyos;

en: You disowned the Holy and Righteous One and asked that a murderer be released to you.
war: Baraan ngan matadong hiya, kundi ginsalikway hiya niyo, ngan iyo lugod pinangaro kan Pilato nga buhian niya an usa nga kriminal.

en: You killed the author of life, but God raised him from the dead. We are witnesses of this.
war: Ginpatay niyo an Burabod han Kinabuhi, kundi ginbanhaw hiya han Dyos, ngan mga saksi kami hini.

en: Anyone who does not listen to him will be completely cut off from their people.’
war: An diri magtuman han igyayakan hadto nga manaragna, igbubulag hira tikang han katawhan han Dyos ngan pupuohon hira.’

en: They seized Peter and John and, because it was evening, they put them in jail until the next day.
war: Sanglit gindakop hira ngan ginpriso ngada han pagkasunod nga adlaw kay tikagab-i na adto.

en: But many who heard the message believed; so the number of men who believed grew to about five thousand.
war: Kundi tinmuo in damo han nagpakabati han mensahe, ngan inmabot na hin mga 5,000 an mga tawo.

en: The next day the rulers, the elders and the teachers of the law met in Jerusalem.
war: Han pagkabuwas nagkatirok didto ha Jerusalem an mga pangulo nga Judiyo, an katigurangan, ngan an mga magturutdo han Balaod.

en: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit, said to them: “Rulers and elders of the people!
war: Binmaton hi Pedro nga puno han Espiritu Santo, “Mga pangulo han mga tawo ngan mga katigurangan:

en: But since they could see the man who had been healed standing there with them, there was nothing they could say.
war: Kundi waray gud nira sadang igriwa kay nakita hira han tawo nga naupay na nga natindog upod nira Pedro ug Juan.

en: So they ordered them to withdraw from the Sanhedrin and then conferred together.
war: Sanglit ginpagawas hira han ruwang han Labaw nga Hukmanan ngan naghirohimangraw hin hira la,

en: As for us, we cannot help speaking about what we have seen and heard.”
war: Kay diri kami kapupugngan hin pagyakan han amon hinkit-an ngan hinbatian.”

en: For the man who was miraculously healed was over forty years old.
war: Sobra na hin 40 ka tuig an edad han tawo nga ginbuhatan hini nga milagro hin pagtambal.

en: The kings of the earth rise up and the rulers band together against the Lord and against his anointed one. ’
war: Nag-andam an kahadian han tuna, ngan nagkatirok an mga punoan kontra han Ginoo ngan han iya Mesiyas.’

en: They did what your power and will had decided beforehand should happen.
war: Nagkaurosa hira hin pagbuhat han bisan ano, nga pinaagi han imo gahom ug pagbuot, imo na nga daan ginlarang nga mahinanabo.

en: Then some young men came forward, wrapped up his body, and carried him out and buried him.
war: Dinmaop an mga batan-on nga kalalaken-an, ginputos an iya lawas, gindara hiya ha gawas, ngan iginlubong.

en: About three hours later his wife came in, not knowing what had happened.
war: Pag-agi hin mga tulo ka oras, sinmulod an iya asawa, kundi diri hiya maaram han nahinabo.

en: Great fear seized the whole church and all who heard about these events.
war: Duro gud an kahadlok han bug-os nga singbahan ngan han ngatanan nga nagpakabati hini.

en: No one else dared join them, even though they were highly regarded by the people.
war: Waray taga gawas han hugpo nga nagpasipara hin pagtampo ha ira bisan kon hitaas an pagtahod ha ira han mga tawo.

en: Nevertheless, more and more men and women believed in the Lord and were added to their number.
war: Kundi nagtikadamo an mga tawo nga nahidugang han ira hugpo—kadam-an nga kalalaken-an ngan kababayen-an nga tinmoo han Ginoo.

en: They arrested the apostles and put them in the public jail.
war: Gindakop nira an mga apostoles ngan iginsulod ha prisohan.

en: “Go, stand in the temple courts,” he said, “and tell the people all about this new life.”
war: “Kadto ngan tindog kamo didto ha Templo ngan pagsumati an mga tawo mahitungod hini nga bag-o nga kinabuhi.”

en: The apostles were brought in and made to appear before the Sanhedrin to be questioned by the high priest.
war: Ginpasulod nira an mga apostoles, ginpaatubang han Labaw nga Hukmanan, ngan ginpakianhan hira han Labaw nga Padi.

en: Peter and the other apostles replied: “We must obey God rather than human beings!
war: Binmaton hi Pedro ngan an iba nga mga apostoles, “Kinahanglan pagsugton namon an Dyos, diri an mga tawo.

en: The God of our ancestors raised Jesus from the dead—whom you killed by hanging him on a cross.
war: Nagbanhaw kan Jesus an Dyos han amon kaapoy-apoyan kahuman niyo pataya hiya pinaagi hin pagraysangan ha iya ha kros.

en: We are witnesses of these things, and so is the Holy Spirit, whom God has given to those who obey him.”
war: Mga saksi kami hini nga mga butang—kami ngan an Espiritu Santo nga amo an hatag han Dyos hadton mga nagsusugot ha iya.”

en: When they heard this, they were furious and wanted to put them to death.
war: Han pakabati hini han mga kaapi han Labaw nga Hukmanan, uraura gud an ira kasina, nga karuyag nira ipapatay an mga apostoles.

en: and will give our attention to prayer and the ministry of the word.”
war: Tungod hini magagamit namon an amon bug-os nga panahon hin pag-ampo ngan pagwali.”

en: They presented these men to the apostles, who prayed and laid their hands on them.
war: Gindara hira han hugpo ngadto han mga apostoles, ngan an mga apostoles nag-ampo ngan nagpandong han ira mga kamot ha ira.

en: But they could not stand up against the wisdom the Spirit gave him as he spoke.
war: Kundi an Espiritu naghatag kan Esteban hin dako nga kinaadman, sanglit waray gud hira makakabaton ha iya.

en: Then the high priest asked Stephen, “Are these charges true?”
war: Nagpakiana kan Esteban an Labaw nga Padi, “Matuod ba ini?”

en: ‘Leave your country and your people,’ God said, ‘and go to the land I will show you.’
war: Ngan ginsiring hiya, ‘Bayai an imo panimalay ngan an imo nasod ngan kadto han tuna nga igpapakita ko ha imo.’

en: On their second visit, Joseph told his brothers who he was, and Pharaoh learned about Joseph’s family.
war: Han ikaduha nira nga pagkadto, nagpakilala hi Jose han iya kabugtoan, ngan nakilala ni Paraon an panimalay ni Jose.

en: Then Jacob went down to Egypt, where he and our ancestors died.
war: Ngan kinmadto hi Jacob ha Ehipto diin namatay hiya ngan an iya mga anak.

en: Then ‘a new king, to whom Joseph meant nothing, came to power in Egypt.’
war: Niyan may sinmaliwan hin paghadi ha Ehipto nga diri nakilala kan Jose.

en: Moses was educated in all the wisdom of the Egyptians and was powerful in speech and action.
war: Gintutdoan hi Moises han ngatanan nga kinaadman han mga taga-Ehipto, ngan nagin bantogan hiya ha pulong ug ha buhat.

en: “When Moses was forty years old, he decided to visit his own people, the Israelites.
war: “Han 40 na ka tuig an edad ni Moises naghunahuna hiya hin pagduaw han iya mga igkasi-Israelita.

en: Are you thinking of killing me as you killed the Egyptian yesterday?’
war: Buot mo ba patayon ako sugad han pagpatay mo han Ehiptohanon kakulop?’

en: who enjoyed God’s favor and asked that he might provide a dwelling place for the God of Jacob.
war: Nakalipay han Dyos hi David, ngan naghangyo hiya han Dyos nga tugotan hiya hin pagtindog hin urokyan han Dyos ni Jacob.

en: But it was Solomon who built a house for him.
war: Kundi hi Solomon na an nagtindog hini nga balay.

en: “However, the Most High does not live in houses made by human hands. As the prophet says:
war: “Kundi diri nag-uokoy an Labi ka Harangdon nga Dyos ha mga balay nga gintindog hin mga tawo; sumala han siring han manaragna:

en: Has not my hand made all these things?’
war: Diri ba ako ngahaw an naghimo hini ngatanan nga mga butang?’

en: you who have received the law that was given through angels but have not obeyed it.”
war: Hi kamo an kinmarawat han Balaod han Dyos nga iginhatag pinaagi hin mga anghel, kundi waray ini niyo pagtumana!”

en: “Look,” he said, “I see heaven open and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God.”
war: Nagsiring hiya, “Kitaa, nakita ako nga nabuksan an langit ngan an Anak han Tawo nga natindog ha tuo han Dyos!”

en: At this they covered their ears and, yelling at the top of their voices, they all rushed at him,
war: Sinagpo han ira mga kamot an ira mga talinga upod in paggoliat, ngan nagdurungan hira ngatanan hin pagdasmag ha iya.

en: While they were stoning him, Stephen prayed, “Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.”
war: Ginbinato nira hi Esteban samtang nag-aampo hiya han Ginoo nga nasiring, “Ginoo nga Jesus, karawata an akon espiritu!”

en: Those who had been scattered preached the word wherever they went.
war: An nagkaburublag nga mga magtinuohon napakadto ha magkalainlain nga dapit ngan nagpasangyaw han mensahe.

en: Philip went down to a city in Samaria and proclaimed the Messiah there.
war: Kinmadto hi Felipe ha syudad ha Samaria ngan didto iginwali niya ha mga tawo an Mesiyas.

en: So there was great joy in that city.
war: Sanglit nagkamay-ada dako nga kalipay ha bug-os nga Samaria.

en: They followed him because he had amazed them for a long time with his sorcery.
war: Sulod hin maiha nga panahon nakapahiburong hiya ha ira tungod han iya salamangka, sanglit pinamatian gud hiya nira.

en: When they arrived, they prayed for the new believers there that they might receive the Holy Spirit,
war: Han pag-abot nira, nag-ampo hira para han mga magtinuohon basi makarawat nira han Espiritu Santo.

en: because the Holy Spirit had not yet come on any of them; they had simply been baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
war: Kay waray pa man kumunsad an Espiritu Santo ha bisan usa ha ira; ginbunyagan la hira ha ngaran han Ginoo nga Jesus.

en: Then Peter and John placed their hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.
war: Niyan iginpandong nira Pedro ug Juan an ira mga kamot ha ira, ngan kinarawat nira an Espiritu Santo.

en: You have no part or share in this ministry, because your heart is not right before God.
war: Waray ka bahin o labot han amon buruhaton kay diri matadong an imo kasingkasing ha atubangan han Dyos.

en: For I see that you are full of bitterness and captive to sin.”
war: Kay kinikita ko nga duro gud an imo kaawa ngan napripriso ka han sala.”

en: The Spirit told Philip, “Go to that chariot and stay near it.”
war: Nagsiring kan Felipe an Espiritu Santo, “Kadtoa ngan duoka ito nga karuwahe.”

en: Then Philip began with that very passage of Scripture and told him the good news about Jesus.
war: Sanglit gin-asoyan hiya ni Felipe han Maupay nga Sumat mahitungod kan Jesus tikang gud dinhe hini nga bahin han Kasuratan.

en: As he neared Damascus on his journey, suddenly a light from heaven flashed around him.
war: Han nagtitikahirani na hi Saulo han syudad han Damasco, tigda la nga nalukop hiya hin kapawa nga tikang ha langit.

en: He fell to the ground and heard a voice say to him, “Saul, Saul, why do you persecute me?”
war: Natumba hiya ngan hinbatian niya in tingog nga nasiring ha iya, “Saulo, Saulo, kay ano nga ginpapakurian mo ako?”

en: “Who are you, Lord?” Saul asked. “I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting,” he replied.
war: Nagpakiana hiya, “Hin-o ka ba, Ginoo?” Binmaton an tingog, “Amo ako hi Jesus nga imo ginpapakurian.

en: “Now get up and go into the city, and you will be told what you must do.”
war: Buhat ngan pakadto ha syudad, ngan didto pagsusumatan ka kon ano an imo pagbubuhaton.”

en: For three days he was blind, and did not eat or drink anything.
war: Sulod hin tulo ka adlaw waray hiya pakakita, ngan hito nga panahon waray hiya kumaon o uminom.

en: I will show him how much he must suffer for my name.”
war: Ngan ako ngahaw an magpapakita ha iya han ngatanan nga iya pag-aantoson tungod ha akon.”

en: At once he began to preach in the synagogues that Jesus is the Son of God.
war: Kinmadto dayon hiya ha mga sinagoga ngan nagwali nga hi Jesus amo an Anak han Dyos.

en: After many days had gone by, there was a conspiracy among the Jews to kill him,
war: Paglabay hin damo nga mga adlaw, nagkatirok an mga Judiyo ngan naglarang hira hin pagpatay kan Saulo;

en: but Saul learned of their plan. Day and night they kept close watch on the city gates in order to kill him.
war: kundi hinbaroan ini niya. Ginbantayan nira adlaw gab-i an mga portahan han syudad basi patayon hiya.

en: When the believers learned of this, they took him down to Caesarea and sent him off to Tarsus.
war: Han paghibaro han mga magtinuohon mahitungod hini, gindara nira hi Saulo ngadto ha Cesarea, ngan ginpakadto hiya ha Tarso.

en: All those who lived in Lydda and Sharon saw him and turned to the Lord.
war: Nakakita ha iya an ngatanan nga mga tawo nga nag-uokoy ha Lida ngan ha Saron, ngan tinmoo hira han Ginoo.

en: This became known all over Joppa, and many people believed in the Lord.
war: Nahibantog ini ha bug-os nga Jope, ngan damo nga mga tawo in tinmoo han Ginoo.

en: Peter stayed in Joppa for some time with a tanner named Simon.
war: Nagpabilin hi Pedro ha Jope sulod hin pira pa ka adlaw upod kan Simon nga paratina hin anit.

en: At Caesarea there was a man named Cornelius, a centurion in what was known as the Italian Regiment.
war: May usa ka tawo ha Cesarea nga ginngangaranan kan Cornelio, usa nga kapitan han kasondalohan nga Italyano.

en: Now send men to Joppa to bring back a man named Simon who is called Peter.
war: Ngan yana pagsugo hin mga tawo ngadto ha Jope hin pakigkita hin usa ka tawo, hi Simon, nga ginngangaranan kan Pedro.

en: He is staying with Simon the tanner, whose house is by the sea.”
war: Aadto nalungon hiya kan Simon nga paratina hin anit, nga an balay aada ha ligid han dagat.”

en: He told them everything that had happened and sent them to Joppa.
war: Ginsumatan niya hira han nahinabo ngan ginpakadto hira ha Jope.

en: He became hungry and wanted something to eat, and while the meal was being prepared, he fell into a trance.
war: Ginutom hiya ngan karuyag kumaon. Samtang gin-aandam an pagkaon, nakakita hiya hin panan-awon.

en: It contained all kinds of four-footed animals, as well as reptiles and birds.
war: Nakada sulod hini an ngatanan nga mga mananap nga naglalakat ngan nagkakamang, ngan ihalas nga katamsihan.

en: Then a voice told him, “Get up, Peter. Kill and eat.”
war: May tingog nga nagsiring ha iya, “Tindog, Pedro; pag-ihaw ngan kaon!”

en: The voice spoke to him a second time, “Do not call anything impure that God has made clean.”
war: Nagyakan liwat an tingog ha iya, “Ayaw paghunahunaa nga mahugaw an bisan ano nga ginsiring na han Dyos nga malinis.”

en: This happened three times, and immediately the sheet was taken back to heaven.
war: Nahinabo ini makatulo, ngan kahuman, iginbalik an iya hinkit-an ngadto ha langit.

en: They called out, asking if Simon who was known as Peter was staying there.
war: Nagsangpit hira ngan nagpakiana, “May sumasaka ba dinhe nga ginngangaranan kan Simon Pedro?”

en: So get up and go downstairs. Do not hesitate to go with them, for I have sent them.”
war: Sanglit lusad ngan ayaw pag-alang hin pag-upod ha ira kay akon hira ginsugo.”

en: As Peter entered the house, Cornelius met him and fell at his feet in reverence.
war: Han tisakob na hi Pedro, gintapo hiya ni Cornelio nga linmuhod ngan yimukbo ha iya atubangan.

en: But Peter made him get up. “Stand up,” he said, “I am only a man myself.”
war: Kundi ginpabuhat hiya ni Pedro ngan ginsiring, “Tindog; tawo la ako pareho man ha imo.”

en: While talking with him, Peter went inside and found a large gathering of people.
war: Nakighinimangraw hi Pedro kan Cornelio samtang nasulod hiya han balay diin hinkit-an niya in damo nga mga tawo nga nagkatirok.

en: and said, ‘Cornelius, God has heard your prayer and remembered your gifts to the poor.
war: ngan nagsiring: ‘Cornelio! Pinamatian han Dyos an imo mga pag-ampo ngan nahinumdoman an imo mga buhat ha kalooy.

en: Then Peter began to speak: “I now realize how true it is that God does not show favoritism
war: Nagtikang hi Pedro hin pamulong, “Hinsasabtan ko na yana nga matuod gud man nga waray han Dyos pinalabi.

en: but accepts from every nation the one who fears him and does what is right.
war: Kinakarawat niya an may kahadlok ha iya ngan nagbubuhat han matadong, bisan kon ano nga tulin hin katawhan hiya.

en: but God raised him from the dead on the third day and caused him to be seen.
war: Kundi ginbanhaw hiya han Dyos ha ikatulo ka adlaw, ngan pinmakita hiya,

en: While Peter was still speaking these words, the Holy Spirit came on all who heard the message.
war: Samtang nagyayakan pa hi Pedro, kinmunsad an Espiritu Santo ngada han ngatanan nga namamati han iya mensahe.

en: and said, “You went into the house of uncircumcised men and ate with them.”
war: “Kay ano nga nakig-usa ka hadton diri tinori nga mga Hentil ngan nakigsaro ka pa ngani ha ira?”

en: Starting from the beginning, Peter told them the whole story:
war: Sanglit iginsaysay ha ira hin tukib ni Pedro an nahinabo tikang gud ha tinikangan:

en: Then I heard a voice telling me, ‘Get up, Peter. Kill and eat.’
war: Niyan nakabati ako hin tingog nga nagsiring ha akon, ‘Pedro, tindog; pag-ihaw ngan kaon!’

en: “The voice spoke from heaven a second time, ‘Do not call anything impure that God has made clean.’
war: Nagyakan liwat an tingog tikang ha langit, ‘Ayaw paghunahunaa nga mahugaw in bisan ano nga ginsiring na han Dyos nga malinis.’

en: This happened three times, and then it was all pulled up to heaven again.
war: Nahinabo ini makatulo ngan kahuman, iginbalik an akon hinkit-an ngadto ha langit.

en: “Right then three men who had been sent to me from Caesarea stopped at the house where I was staying.
war: Hito manta nga takna inmabot ha balay nga akon sinak-an in tulo ka tawo nga ginsugo tikang ha Cesarea.

en: He will bring you a message through which you and all your household will be saved.’
war: Magyayakan hiya ha iyo hin mga pulong nga makakatalwas ha imo ngan han bug-os mo nga panimalay.’

en: The Lord’s hand was with them, and a great number of people believed and turned to the Lord.
war: Nakada ha ira an gahom han Ginoo, ngan tinmoo in damo kaupay nga mga tawo, ngan nakabig hira ngadto ha Ginoo.

en: News of this reached the church in Jerusalem, and they sent Barnabas to Antioch.
war: Inmabot ha singbahan ha Jerusalem an sumat mahitungod hini, sanglit ginsugo nira hi Bernabe ngadto ha Antioquia.

en: Then Barnabas went to Tarsus to look for Saul,
war: Niyan kinmadto hi Bernabe ha Tarso hin pagbiling kan Saulo.

en: During this time some prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch.
war: Hadto nga panahon inmabot ha Antioquia in mga manaragna nga tikang ha Jerusalem.

en: This they did, sending their gift to the elders by Barnabas and Saul.
war: Ginbuhat nira ini, ngan ginpadara nira an kwarta kanda Bernabe ug Saulo ngadto han mga katigurangan han singbahan.

en: It was about this time that King Herod arrested some who belonged to the church, intending to persecute them.
war: Hini nga panahon nagtikang hi Hadi Herodes hin pagpakurii in pira nga mga kaapi han singbahan.

en: He had James, the brother of John, put to death with the sword.
war: Iginpapatay niya pinaagi hin espada hi Santiago nga bugto ni Juan.

en: But Peter kept on knocking, and when they opened the door and saw him, they were astonished.
war: Nagpadayon hin pagtuktok hi Pedro, ngan han pag-abrehi na nira han porta ngan han pakakita nira ha iya, nahipausa hira.

en: In the morning, there was no small commotion among the soldiers as to what had become of Peter.
war: Han pagkaaga na duro an kalisang han mga gwardya kon ano an nahinabo kan Pedro.

en: They shouted, “This is the voice of a god, not of a man.”
war: Naggoliat an mga tawo, “Diri ini tawo nga nagyayakan, kundi usa nga diyos!”

en: But the word of God continued to spread and flourish.
war: Nagpadayon hin paglurab ngan pagtubo an pulong han Dyos.

en: Then Saul, who was also called Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, looked straight at Elymas and said,
war: Niyan hi Saulo—nga kinikilala liwat nga Pablo, nga puno han Espiritu Santo, sinmiplat hiya han salamangkero,

en: for about forty years he endured their conduct in the wilderness;
war: ngan sulod hin 40 ka tuig gin-ilob niya hira didto ha kamingawan.

en: and he overthrew seven nations in Canaan, giving their land to his people as their inheritance.
war: Ginbungkag niya in pito nga mga nasod didto ha tuna han Canaan, ngan ginhatag ini ha ira ngan ginpatag-iya hira hini nga tuna.

en: “From this man’s descendants God has brought to Israel the Savior Jesus, as he promised.
war: Hi Jesus nga tulin ni David amo an ginhimo han Dyos nga Magtaralwas han katawhan han Israel sumala han iya iginsaad.

en: But God raised him from the dead,
