en: Now a man named Micah from the hill country of Ephraim
war: May-ada hadto usa ka tawo nga ginngaranan kan Miqueas, nga nag-ukoy didto han sagkahon nga nasod han Efraim.

en: In those days Israel had no king; everyone did as they saw fit.
war: Waray hadi didto ha Israel hito nga panahon; nagbuhat an kada tawo han bisan ano nga iya karuyag.

en: A young Levite from Bethlehem in Judah, who had been living within the clan of Judah,
war: Hito ngahaw nga panahon may-ada usa nga batan-on nga Levita nga nag-ukoy anay didto han bungto han Betlehem ha Juda.

en: So the Levite agreed to live with him, and the young man became like one of his sons to him.
war: Inmuyon an batan-on nga Levita hin pagpabilin upod kan Miqueas ngan nahimo hiya nga sugad hin usa han iya mga anak.

en: Then Micah installed the Levite, and the young man became his priest and lived in his house.
war: Gintudlok hiya nga padi ni Miqueas ngan nag-ukoy hiya didto han balay ni Miqueas.

en: He told them what Micah had done for him, and said, “He has hired me and I am his priest.”
war: Binmaton hiya, “May-ada kami ginkasabotan ngan hi Miqueas nga nagsusuhol ha akon ha pag-alagad ko nga padi para ha iya.”

en: The priest answered them, “Go in peace. Your journey has the Lord ’s approval.”
war: Binmaton an padi, “Waray niyo sadang kabarak-an. Ginmamangnoan kamo han Ginoo dida hini nga iyo paglakaton.”

en: From there they went on to the hill country of Ephraim and came to Micah’s house.
war: Tikang didto nagpadayon hira ngan inmabot hira ha balay ni Miqueas didto han sagkahon nga nasod han Efraim.

en: So they turned in there and went to the house of the young Levite at Micah’s place and greeted him.
war: Sanglit sinmulod hira ngadto han balay hi Miqueas, nga inuokyan han batan-on nga Levita, ngan pinangumosta nira an Levita.

en: Putting their little children, their livestock and their possessions in front of them, they turned away and left.
war: Binmalik hira ngan nagkalakat hira. Nag-una ha ira an ira kabataan, ira kabakahan, ngan an ira mga higamit.

en: Now, all you Israelites, speak up and tell me what you have decided to do.”
war: Mga Israelita kamo ngatanan nga aanhi. Ano an aton bubuhaton mahitungod hini?”

en: But now this is what we’ll do to Gibeah: We’ll go up against it in the order decided by casting lots.
war: Amo ini an aton bubuhaton: magriripa kita ngan magpipili hin mga tawo nga masulong han Gabaa.

en: So all the Israelites got together and united as one against the city.
war: Sanglit nagkatirok an ngatanan nga kalalaken-an didto ha Israel ngan usa la an ira tuyo—pagsulong han bungto.

en: The next morning the Israelites got up and pitched camp near Gibeah.
war: Sanglit han pagkaaga nagkalakat an mga Israelita ngan nagkampo hira hirani han syudad han Gabaa.

en: Then the Israelites drew near to Benjamin the second day.
war: Ginsulong nira hin ika duha an kasondalohan han Benjamin.

en: Then Israel set an ambush around Gibeah.
war: Sanglit ginpatago han mga Israelita an iba han mga sondalo palibot han Gabaa.

en: Eighteen thousand Benjamites fell, all of them valiant fighters.
war: Pinamatay in 18,000 han gimamag-upayi nga Benjaminhon nga mga sondalo.

en: For when they counted the people, they found that none of the people of Jabesh Gilead were there.
war: han pagpundoka han mga tawo waray didto taga-Habes.

en: “This is what you are to do,” they said. “Kill every male and every woman who is not a virgin.”
war: Pamataya an ngatanan nga kalalaken-an ngan an ngatanan nga kababayen-an nga diri na uray.”

en: The people grieved for Benjamin, because the Lord had made a gap in the tribes of Israel.
war: Nabido an mga tawo tungod han mga Benjaminhon kay ginbungkag han Ginoo an pagkaurosa han mga tribo han Israel.

en: So they instructed the Benjamites, saying, “Go and hide in the vineyards
war: Ginsiring nira an mga Benjaminhon, “Pakadto ngan panago kamo didto han mga urubasan

en: In those days Israel had no king; everyone did as they saw fit.
war: Waray hadi didto ha Israel hadto nga panahon. Nagbuhat an kada tawo han bisan ano nga iya karuyag.

en: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
war: Han waray pa himoa an kalibutan, nakada na an Pulong. Kausa han Dyos an Pulong, ngan Dyos gud an Pulong.

en: He was with God in the beginning.
war: Tikang pa ha tinikangan kausa na han Dyos an Pulong.

en: In him was life, and that life was the light of all mankind.
war: Dida han Pulong nakada an kinabuhi, ngan an kinabuhi amo an kapawa han mga tawo.

en: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness has not overcome it.
war: An kapawa naglamrag dida han kasisidman, ngan an kasisidman waray gud makaparong ha iya.

en: There was a man sent from God whose name was John.
war: May-ada tawo nga Juan an ngaran nga ginsugo han Dyos

en: He came as a witness to testify concerning that light, so that through him all might believe.
war: hin pagsumat han mga tawo mahitungod han kapawa, basi an ngatanan makabati han mensahe ngan tumoo.

en: He himself was not the light; he came only as a witness to the light.
war: Diri hiya amo an kapawa; kinmanhi hiya hin pagsumat mahitungod han kapawa.

en: The true light that gives light to everyone was coming into the world.
war: Amo ini an matuod nga kapawa—an kapawa nga nakanhi ha kalibutan ngan nakalamrag han ngatanan nga katawhan.

en: He came to that which was his own, but his own did not receive him.
war: Kinmanhi hiya han iya kalugaringon nga tuna, kundi waray hiya karawata han iya kalugaringon nga katawhan.

en: He did not fail to confess, but confessed freely, “I am not the Messiah.”
war: Waray hiya maglirong, kundi nagsumat hin waray lipodlipod, “Diri ako an Mesiyas.”

en: Now the Pharisees who had been sent
war: An mga tawo nga ginsugo han mga Parisiyo

en: questioned him, “Why then do you baptize if you are not the Messiah, nor Elijah, nor the Prophet?”
war: nagpakiana kan Juan, “Kay ano nga nagbubunyag ka man, kon diri ka man ngay-an an Mesiyas, o hi Elias, o an Manaragna?”

en: “I baptize with water,” John replied, “but among you stands one you do not know.
war: Binmaton hi Juan, “Nagbubunyag ako hin tubig, kundi may usa dida ha iyo nga diri niyo kinikilala.

en: He is the one who comes after me, the straps of whose sandals I am not worthy to untie.”
war: Masunod hiya ha akon, kundi diri ngani ako takos bisan hin paghukas han iya sandalyas.”

en: This all happened at Bethany on the other side of the Jordan, where John was baptizing.
war: Nahinabo ini ngatanan didto ha Betania, sinirangan nga dapit han Salog han Jordan, diin namumunyag hi Juan.

en: I have seen and I testify that this is God’s Chosen One.”
war: Akon ito hinkit-an, ngan nagsusumat ako ha iyo nga hiya amo an Anak han Dyos.”

en: The next day John was there again with two of his disciples.
war: Han pagkasunod nga adlaw didto na liwat hi Juan upod in duha niya nga mga tinun-an.

en: When he saw Jesus passing by, he said, “Look, the Lamb of God!”
war: Han pakakita niya kan Jesus nga nalabay, nagsiring hiya, “Kitaa, iini an Kordero han Dyos!”

en: When the two disciples heard him say this, they followed Jesus.
war: Nakabati an duha niya nga mga tinun-an han iya pagsiring hini, ngan binmunyog hira kan Jesus.

en: Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, was one of the two who heard what John had said and who had followed Jesus.
war: Usa han duha nga nakabati kan Juan ngan binmunyog kan Jesus, amo hi Andres nga bugto ni Simon Pedro.

en: Philip, like Andrew and Peter, was from the town of Bethsaida.
war: Taga-Betsaida ini hi Felipe, ngan amo liwat an bungto nira Andres ug Pedro.)

en: Then Nathanael declared, “Rabbi, you are the Son of God; you are the king of Israel.”
war: Nagsiring hi Natanael, “Magturutdo, ikaw an Anak han Dyos, ikaw an Hadi han Israel!”

en: On the third day a wedding took place at Cana in Galilee. Jesus’ mother was there,
war: Paghagos hin duha ka adlaw, nagkaada kasal didto ha bungto han Cana, ha Galilea. Nakadto an iroy ni Jesus.

en: and Jesus and his disciples had also been invited to the wedding.
war: Gindapit liwat ngadto hini nga pagkasal hi Jesus, pati an iya mga tinun-an.

en: When the wine was gone, Jesus’ mother said to him, “They have no more wine.”
war: Han kaubos na han bino, ginsiring hi Jesus han iroy niya, “Waray na hira bino.”

en: “Woman, why do you involve me?” Jesus replied. “My hour has not yet come.”
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Babaye, ayaw ako pagbut-i han akon bubuhaton. Waray pa abot an akon panahon.”

en: His mother said to the servants, “Do whatever he tells you.”
war: Gintugon han iroy ni Jesus an mga surugoon, “Buhata gud an bisan ano nga igsugo niya ha iyo.”

en: Jesus said to the servants, “Fill the jars with water” ; so they filled them to the brim.
war: Ginsiring ni Jesus an mga surugoon, “Pun-a niyo hin tubig ini nga mga tadyaw.” Ginpuno nira ini tubtob ha ganggang,

en: When it was almost time for the Jewish Passover, Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
war: Hiraniay na an Pyesta han Paglabay han mga Judiyo, sanglit napakadto hi Jesus ha Jerusalem.

en: Jesus answered them, “Destroy this temple, and I will raise it again in three days.”
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Bungkaga niyo ini nga balay han Dyos ngan titindogon ko liwat sulod hin tulo ka adlaw.”

en: They replied, “It has taken forty-six years to build this temple, and you are going to raise it in three days?”
war: “Kwarentay seis ka tuig an pagtindog hini nga templo, ngan titindogon mo ini sulod la hin tulo ka adlaw?” nagpakiana hira.

en: But the temple he had spoken of was his body.
war: Kundi an Templo nga karuyag sidngon ni Jesus, amo an iya lawas.

en: But Jesus would not entrust himself to them, for he knew all people.
war: Kundi waray tumagya ha ira hi Jesus, kay sayod hiya kaupay han ngatanan nga mga tawo.

en: He did not need any testimony about mankind, for he knew what was in each person.
war: Waray na kinahanglan nga sumatan pa hiya mahitungod han mga tawo, kay daan hiya sayod kon ano an aada ha ira mga kasingkasing.

en: Now there was a Pharisee, a man named Nicodemus who was a member of the Jewish ruling council.
war: May-ada tawo nga Nicodemo an ngaran, usa nga pangulo han mga Judiyo, nga sakop han hugpo han mga Parisiyo.

en: Flesh gives birth to flesh, but the Spirit gives birth to spirit.
war: Tikang hin mga kag-anak an lawasnon nga pagkatawo; kundi tikang han Espiritu an espirituhanon nga pagkatawo.

en: You should not be surprised at my saying, ‘You must be born again.’
war: Ayaw hipausa nga nasiring ako ha imo, ‘Kinahanglan matawo na liwat kamo ngatanan!’

en: “How can this be?” Nicodemus asked.
war: “Uunanhon man ini?” nagpakiana hi Nicodemo.

en: “You are Israel’s teacher,” said Jesus, “and do you not understand these things?
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Bantogan ka nga magturutdo ha Israel, ngan diri ka ba nakakasabot hini?

en: No one has ever gone into heaven except the one who came from heaven—the Son of Man.
war: Ngan waray pagud nakasaka ha langit labot han Anak han Tawo nga linmusad tikang ha langit!”

en: that everyone who believes may have eternal life in him.”
war: basi makaangkon han dayon nga kinabuhi an ngatanan nga natoo ha iya.

en: (This was before John was put in prison.)
war: Waray pa hadto kapriso hi Juan.)

en: An argument developed between some of John’s disciples and a certain Jew over the matter of ceremonial washing.
war: May mga tinun-an ni Juan nga nakiglantugi hin usa nga Judiyo mahitungod hin turumanon han tuluohan bahin hin paglinis.

en: To this John replied, “A person can receive only what is given them from heaven.
war: Nagbaton hi Juan, “Waray maaangkon in bisan hin-o labot kon ihatag ito ha iya han Dyos.

en: You yourselves can testify that I said, ‘I am not the Messiah but am sent ahead of him.’
war: Kamo ngahaw an akon mga saksi nga nagsiring ako, ‘Diri ako amo an Mesiyas, kundi ginsugo ako una ha iya.’

en: He must become greater; I must become less.”
war: Kinahanglan magtikadungganan hiya, samtang magtikaubos ako.”

en: He testifies to what he has seen and heard, but no one accepts his testimony.
war: Nagsusumat hiya han iya hinkit-an ngan hinbatian, kundi waray nakarawat han iya mensahe.

en: Whoever has accepted it has certified that God is truthful.
war: Bisan hin-o nga nakarawat han iya mensahe, nagpapamatuod nga kasasarigan an Dyos.

en: The Father loves the Son and has placed everything in his hands.
war: Nahigugma an Amay han iya Anak ngan igintapod ha iya gahom an ngatanan nga mga butang.

en: although in fact it was not Jesus who baptized, but his disciples.
war: Ha tinuod diri hi Jesus ngahaw an nanmunyag, kundi an iya la mga tinun-an.)

en: So he left Judea and went back once more to Galilee.
war: Han paghibaro ni Jesus hini, binmaya anay hiya han Judea, ngan binmalik ngadto ha Galilea.

en: Now he had to go through Samaria.
war: Maagi gud hiya ha Samaria kon makadto hiya ha Galilea.

en: “Sir,” the woman said, “you have nothing to draw with and the well is deep. Where can you get this living water?
war: Nagsiring an babaye, “Hain ka man kukuha hito nga tubig, kay waray ka man ikarabo, ngan hilarom an atabay?

en: Jesus answered, “Everyone who drinks this water will be thirsty again,
war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Uuhawon la gihapon an bisan hin-o nga mainom hini nga tubig,

en: He told her, “Go, call your husband and come back.”
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya, “Kadto na, tawaga an imo bana ngan balik nganhi.”

en: “I have no husband,” she replied. Jesus said to her, “You are right when you say you have no husband.
war: “Waray ako asawa,” nagsiring an babaye. Binmaton hi Jesus, “Tama an imo siring nga waray ka bana,

en: The fact is, you have had five husbands, and the man you now have is not your husband. What you have just said is quite true.”
war: kay lima na an imo iginkaasawa, ngan diri mo bana iton iginkakalungon mo yana. Matuod gud an imo siring.”

en: “Sir,” the woman said, “I can see that you are a prophet.
war: “Naabat ako nga usa ka nga manaragna,” nagsiring an babaye.

en: God is spirit, and his worshipers must worship in the Spirit and in truth.”
war: Espiritu an Dyos, ngan kinahanglan magsingba ha espiritu ngan ha kamatuoran an mga nagsisingba ha iya.”

en: Then Jesus declared, “I, the one speaking to you—I am he.”
war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Ako amo hiya, ako nga nakikighimangraw ha imo.”

en: Then, leaving her water jar, the woman went back to the town and said to the people,
war: Binayaan han babaye an iya tibod ngan binmalik ngadto ha bungto. Nagsiring hiya ha mga tawo didto,

en: “Come, see a man who told me everything I ever did. Could this be the Messiah?”
war: “Tana, kitaa niyo an tawo nga nagsumat ha akon han ngatanan nga akon nabuhat. Amo na ba hiya an Mesiyas?”

en: They came out of the town and made their way toward him.
war: Sanglit binayaan nira an bungto ngan napakadto hira kan Jesus.

en: Meanwhile his disciples urged him, “Rabbi, eat something.”
war: Hito ngahaw nga takna naghinangyo an mga tinun-an kan Jesus, “Magturutdo, kaon na!”

en: But he said to them, “I have food to eat that you know nothing about.”
war: Kundi nagbaton hiya, “May-ada ako pagkaon nga waray niyo hibabaroi.”

en: Then his disciples said to each other, “Could someone have brought him food?”
war: Sanglit may hin parupakiana an mga tinun-an, “May-ada ba nagdul-ong ha iya hin pagkaon?”

en: Thus the saying ‘One sows and another reaps’ is true.
war: Matuod an darahunon, ‘Usa an nagtatanom, iba an nag-aani.’

en: And because of his words many more became believers.
war: Damo pa in tinmoo tungod han iya mensahe,

en: After the two days he left for Galilee.
war: Katapos hin duha ka adlaw didto, linmakat hi Jesus ngan pinmakadto ha Galilea.

en: (Now Jesus himself had pointed out that a prophet has no honor in his own country.)
war: Hiya ngahaw an nagsiring, “Diri tinutuod an manaragna dida han iya kalugaringon nga tuna.”

en: “Unless you people see signs and wonders,” Jesus told him, “you will never believe.”
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya, “Waray gud ha iyo matoo labot kon hikit-an niyo in dagko nga mga orosahon.”

en: The royal official said, “Sir, come down before my child dies.”
war: Nagbaton an opisyal, “Tana gad, upod ha akon nga diri pa napatay an akon anak.”

en: While he was still on the way, his servants met him with the news that his boy was living.
war: Dida ha dalan, han tipauli hiya, ginsugat hiya han iya mga surugoon upod an sumat nga buhi an iya anak.

en: This was the second sign Jesus performed after coming from Judea to Galilee.
war: Amo ini an ikaduha nga milagro nga ginbuhat ni Jesus han pag-abot niya ha Galilea tikang ha Judea.

en: Some time later, Jesus went up to Jerusalem for one of the Jewish festivals.
war: Katapos hini, nagpyesta an mga Judiyo ngan napakadto hi Jesus ha Jerusalem.

en: Here a great number of disabled people used to lie—the blind, the lame, the paralyzed.
war: Nakada hini nga mga balkon in damo nga mga magsakit—mga buta, mga piay, ngan mga lulid. [Naghuhulat hira nga bumantad an tubig,

en: One who was there had been an invalid for thirty-eight years.
war: May didto usa nga tawo nga 38 ka tuig na an iya kasakit.

en: Then Jesus said to him, “Get up! Pick up your mat and walk.”
war: Ginsiring hiya ni Jesus, “Buhat, dad-a an imo higdaan, ngan lakat.”

en: At once the man was cured; he picked up his mat and walked. The day on which this took place was a Sabbath,
war: Naupay dayon an tawo; gindara niya an iya higdaan, ngan linmakat. Nahinabo ini ha Adlaw nga Iparahuway,

en: But he replied, “The man who made me well said to me, ‘Pick up your mat and walk.’ ”
war: Binmaton hiya, “Ginsiring ako han tawo nga nagtambal ha akon, ‘Dad-a an imo higdaan ngan lakat.’”

en: So they asked him, “Who is this fellow who told you to pick it up and walk?”
war: Nagpakiana hira ha iya, “Hin-o ini nga tawo nga nagsugo ha imo hin pagdara han imo higdaan ngan lakat?”

en: The man went away and told the Jewish leaders that it was Jesus who had made him well.
war: Ngan linmakat an tawo ngan iya ginsumatan an mga punoan nga Judiyo nga hi Jesus an nagtambal ha iya.

en: So, because Jesus was doing these things on the Sabbath, the Jewish leaders began to persecute him.
war: Tungod hini nagtikang hira pagdumot kan Jesus, kay ginbuhat niya ini nga pagtambal ha Adlaw nga Iparahuway.

en: In his defense Jesus said to them, “My Father is always at his work to this very day, and I too am working.”
war: Ginbaton hira ni Jesus, “Dayuday nagbubuhat an akon Amay, sanglit kinahanglan liwat magbuhat ako.”

en: Moreover, the Father judges no one, but has entrusted all judgment to the Son,
war: Diri na maghuhukom an Amay bisan kan kanay. Iginhatag na niya ngadto han iya Anak an bug-os nga katungod hin paghukom,

en: And he has given him authority to judge because he is the Son of Man.
war: Ngan iginhatag ngadto han Anak an katungod hin paghukom, kay Anak han Tawo man hiya.

en: “Do not be amazed at this, for a time is coming when all who are in their graves will hear his voice
war: Ayaw kamo hipausa hini; tiarabot an panahon nga makakabati han iya tingog an ngatanan nga mga minatay ha lubnganan,

en: “If I testify about myself, my testimony is not true.
war: “Kon magsaksi ako ha akon la ngahaw, diri angay karawaton sugad nga tinuod nga pruyba an akon iginsiring.

en: “You have sent to John and he has testified to the truth.
war: Ginpadara niyo an iyo mga sinugo ngadto kan Juan, ngan nagyakan hiya ha ngaran han kamatuoran.

en: Not that I accept human testimony; but I mention it that you may be saved.
war: Diri nga nagkikinahanglan ako hin kanan tawo pagsaksi; ginsusumat ko la ini, basi matalwas unta kamo.

en: nor does his word dwell in you, for you do not believe the one he sent.
war: ngan waray niyo tipigi ha iyo mga kasingkasing an iya mensahe, kay diri man kamo natoo han ginsugo niya.

en: yet you refuse to come to me to have life.
war: Kundi diri niyo karuyag kumadi ha akon basi maangkon niyo an kinabuhi.

en: “I do not accept glory from human beings,
war: “Diri ako nag-uungara nga dayawon ako hin mga tawo.

en: but I know you. I know that you do not have the love of God in your hearts.
war: Kundi nakilala ako ha iyo; maaram ako nga waray kamo gugma para han Dyos ha iyo mga kasingkasing.

en: If you believed Moses, you would believe me, for he wrote about me.
war: Kon tinuod nga natoo kamo kan Moises, matoo unta kamo ha akon, kay nagsurat hiya mahitungod ha akon.

en: But since you do not believe what he wrote, how are you going to believe what I say?”
war: Kundi tungod nga diri man kamo natoo han iya iginsurat, uunanhon hin pakatoo niyo han akon iginsiring?”

en: Some time after this, Jesus crossed to the far shore of the Sea of Galilee (that is, the Sea of Tiberias),
war: Katapos hini, binmalik hi Jesus ngadto ha tabok han Lanaw han Galilea (o Lanaw han Tiberias).

en: Then Jesus went up on a mountainside and sat down with his disciples.
war: Sinmagka hi Jesus hin pungtod ngan linmingkod upod an iya mga tinun-an.

en: The Jewish Passover Festival was near.
war: Hirani na an Pyesta han Paglabay han mga Judiyo.

en: He asked this only to test him, for he already had in mind what he was going to do.
war: Ginsiring ini niya hin pagsari kan Felipe; ha tinuod, maaram hiya nga daan kon ano an iya bubuhaton.)

en: Another of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, spoke up,
war: Nagsiring hi Andres nga bugto ni Simon Pedro, nga usa han iya mga tinun-an,

en: When evening came, his disciples went down to the lake,
war: Han tipagsisirom na, nanlugsong an iya mga tinun-an ngadto han lanaw.

en: A strong wind was blowing and the waters grew rough.
war: Hini nga takna nagmadlos, ngan nagmabalod hin duro.

en: But he said to them, “It is I; don’t be afraid.”
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Ako ini, ayaw kamo kahadlok!”

en: Then they were willing to take him into the boat, and immediately the boat reached the shore where they were heading.
war: Nalipay hira pagpasakay ha iya; ngan dinmuong hira dayon ha dapit nga ira kinakadtoan.

en: When they found him on the other side of the lake, they asked him, “Rabbi, when did you get here?”
war: Han paghiagii kan Jesus han mga tawo didto ha tabok han lanaw, nagsiring hira ha iya, “Magturutdo, kakan-o ka pa abot nganhi?”

en: Then they asked him, “What must we do to do the works God requires?”
war: Sanglit nagpakiana hira ha iya, “Ano man an sadang namon buhaton basi makatuman kami han mga ipinapagbuhat ha amon han Dyos?”

en: Jesus answered, “The work of God is this: to believe in the one he has sent.”
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Amo ini an karuyag han Dyos ipabuhat ha iyo: sarig kamo han iya ginsugo.”

en: For the bread of God is the bread that comes down from heaven and gives life to the world.”
war: Kay an pagkaon nga ihinahatag han Dyos amo hiya nga linmusad tikang ha langit, ngan nahatag hin kinabuhi ha kalibutan.”

en: “Sir,” they said, “always give us this bread.”
war: Ngan naghangyo hira ha iya, “Dayuday tagi kami hini nga pagkaon.”

en: But as I told you, you have seen me and still you do not believe.
war: Ginsiring ko na kamo nga bisan kon hinkit-an ako niyo, diri la gihapon kamo natoo ha akon.

en: All those the Father gives me will come to me, and whoever comes to me I will never drive away.
war: Napakadi ha akon an bisan hin-o nga itinutubyan ha akon han Amay. Diri ko gud isasalikway an bisan hin-o nga mapakadi ha akon,

en: For I have come down from heaven not to do my will but to do the will of him who sent me.
war: kay linmusad ako tikang ha langit diri pagtuman han akon kalugaringon nga kaburot-on, kundi han kaburot-on han nagsugo ha akon.

en: “Stop grumbling among yourselves,” Jesus answered.
war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Ayaw kamo pagnginurutob.

en: No one has seen the Father except the one who is from God; only he has seen the Father.
war: Diri karuyag sidngon hini nga may-ada na nakakita han Amay; hiya la nga tikang han Dyos an nakakita han Amay.

en: Very truly I tell you, the one who believes has eternal life.
war: Susumatan ko kamo hin tinuod; may-ada na dayon nga kinabuhi adton natoo.

en: I am the bread of life.
war: Amo ako an pagkaon nga nahatag han kinabuhi.

en: Your ancestors ate the manna in the wilderness, yet they died.
war: Nangaon han mana didto ha kamingawan an iyo mga ginikanan, kundi nagkamatay hira.

en: But here is the bread that comes down from heaven, which anyone may eat and not die.
war: Kundi diri na mamamatay an nakaon han pagkaon nga tikang ha langit.

en: For my flesh is real food and my blood is real drink.
war: Kay tinuod gud nga pagkaon an akon unod, ngan tinuod gud nga irimnon an akon dugo.

en: Whoever eats my flesh and drinks my blood remains in me, and I in them.
war: An nakaon han akon unod ngan nainom han akon dugo aadi ha akon ngan aada ako ha iya.

en: He said this while teaching in the synagogue in Capernaum.
war: Ginsiring ini ni Jesus samtang nagtutdo hiya didto han sinagoga ha Capernaum.

en: From this time many of his disciples turned back and no longer followed him.
war: Tungod hini, binmulag in damo han iya mga tinun-an ngan waray na bumunyog ha iya.

en: “You do not want to leave too, do you?” Jesus asked the Twelve.
war: Sanglit nagpakiana hi Jesus han dose nga mga tinun-an, “Ngan kamo karuyag ba liwat niyo hin pagbaya ha akon?”

en: Simon Peter answered him, “Lord, to whom shall we go? You have the words of eternal life.
war: Binmaton ha iya hi Simon Pedro, “Ngain pa man kami kakadto, Ginoo? Ikaw an may mga pulong nga nahatag han dayon nga kinabuhi.

en: We have come to believe and to know that you are the Holy One of God.”
war: Ngan yana natoo ngan maaram kami nga amo ka an Baraan nga tikang sa Dyos.”

en: Then Jesus replied, “Have I not chosen you, the Twelve? Yet one of you is a devil!”
war: Nagbaton ha ira hi Jesus, “Diri ba dose kamo nga akon ginpili? Kundi yawa an usa ha iyo!”

en: But when the Jewish Festival of Tabernacles was near,
war: Hirani na an kanan Judiyo Pyesta han mga Tabernakulo,

en: For even his own brothers did not believe in him.
war: Waray pagtoo ha iya bisan ngani an iya kabugtoan.)

en: Therefore Jesus told them, “My time is not yet here; for you any time will do.
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Waray pa umabot an akon igo nga panahon, kundi pirme igo ha iyo an ngatanan nga panahon.

en: You go to the festival. I am not going up to this festival, because my time has not yet fully come.”
war: Kamo na la in pasingadto ha pyesta; diri ako makadto hini nga pyesta; kay waray pa umabot an akon igo nga panahon.”

en: After he had said this, he stayed in Galilee.
war: Iginyakan ini niya ha ira, ngan nagpabilin hiya ha Galilea.

en: However, after his brothers had left for the festival, he went also, not publicly, but in secret.
war: Pinmaorhe hi Jesus han iya kabugtoan hin pagkadto ha pyesta; waray hiya magpadayag, kundi hilit la an iya pagkadto.

en: Now at the festival the Jewish leaders were watching for Jesus and asking, “Where is he?”
war: Nagpinamiling ha iya an mga Judiyo didto han pyesta ngan nagpinakiana hira kon hain hiya.

en: But no one would say anything publicly about him for fear of the leaders.
war: Kundi tungod han ira kahadlok han mga punoan nga Judiyo, waray tawo nga ginmahom hin paghimangraw mahitungod ha iya.

en: Not until halfway through the festival did Jesus go up to the temple courts and begin to teach.
war: Han nagkakatunga na an ira pagsaurog han pyesta, pinmakadto hi Jesus ha Templo ngan nagtutdo.

en: Jesus answered, “My teaching is not my own. It comes from the one who sent me.
war: Nagbaton ha ira hi Jesus, “Diri akon pagturon-an an igintututdo ko, kundi tikang sa Dyos nga nagsugo ha akon.

en: “You are demon-possessed,” the crowd answered. “Who is trying to kill you?”
war: Nagbaton an mga tawo, “May-ada ka gud yawa! Hin-o ngani an nag-iiparatay ha imo?”

en: Jesus said to them, “I did one miracle, and you are all amazed.
war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Usa pa la nga milagro an akon ginbuhat, ngan nahipausa na kamo ngatanan.

en: Stop judging by mere appearances, but instead judge correctly.”
war: Paghukom kamo sumala han tinuod nga lagda; ayaw na paghukom dara la han iyo hinkit-an.”

en: At that point some of the people of Jerusalem began to ask, “Isn’t this the man they are trying to kill?
war: Nagsiring in pira nga mga tawo ha Jerusalem, “Diri ba ini an tawo nga gin-iiparatay nira?

en: but I know him because I am from him and he sent me.”
war: Nakilala ako ha iya, kay tikang ako ha iya, ngan hiya an nagsugo ha akon.”

en: At this they tried to seize him, but no one laid a hand on him, because his hour had not yet come.
war: Ngan gin-idarakop hiya nira, kundi waray naglabot ha iya, kay waray pa man umabot an iya takna.

en: Jesus said, “I am with you for only a short time, and then I am going to the one who sent me.
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus, “Madaliay na la an akon pakig-urosa ha iyo, ngan mabalik na ako ngadto han nagsugo ha akon.

en: You will look for me, but you will not find me; and where I am, you cannot come.”
war: Mamimiling kamo ha akon, kundi diri kamo makakaagi ha akon; kay diri kamo makakakadto han akon kakadtoan.”

en: Whoever believes in me, as Scripture has said, rivers of living water will flow from within them.”
war: Sumala han siring han kasuratan, ‘Tikang ha kasingkasing hadton natoo ha akon maawas in tubig nga nahatag hin kinabuhi.’”

en: On hearing his words, some of the people said, “Surely this man is the Prophet.”
war: Han pakabati han damo nga mga tawo hini nga siring ni Jesus, nabuhag hira. May-ada nasiring, “Amo na gud ini an Manaragna!”

en: Others said, “He is the Messiah.” Still others asked, “How can the Messiah come from Galilee?
war: Nagsiring liwat an iba, “Amo na hiya an Mesiyas!” Kundi nagsiring pa an iba, “Diri matikang ha Galilea an Mesiyas!

en: Thus the people were divided because of Jesus.
war: Sanglit tungod ha iya nagkabuhag an mga tawo.

en: Some wanted to seize him, but no one laid a hand on him.
war: Karuyag magdakop kan Jesus an pira ha ira, kundi waray gud nagpasipara hin pagkapot ha iya.

en: “No one ever spoke the way this man does,” the guards replied.
war: Nagbaton an mga gwardya, “Waray pa gud tawo nga naghimangraw hin sugad nga pagyakan hini nga tawo!”

en: “You mean he has deceived you also?” the Pharisees retorted.
war: Nagpakiana an mga Parisiyo, “Nalimbongan ba liwat kamo niya?

en: “Have any of the rulers or of the Pharisees believed in him?
war: May-ada na ba niyo hinbaroan nga usa han mga punoan o usa nga Parisiyo nga tinmoo ha iya?

en: No! But this mob that knows nothing of the law—there is a curse on them.”
war: Diri nasabot ini nga mga tawo han Balaod ni Moises, sanglit ginpanhimaraot hira han Dyos!”

en: Nicodemus, who had gone to Jesus earlier and who was one of their own number, asked,
war: Usa han mga Parisiyo amo hi Nicodemo nga nakigkita hadto kan Jesus. Nagsiring hiya ha ira,

en: but Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.
war: [Ngan nanguli an ngatanan, kundi napakadto hi Jesus ha Bukid han mga Olibo.

en: and said to Jesus, “Teacher, this woman was caught in the act of adultery.
war: Nagsiring hira kan Jesus, “Magturutdo, hindakpan ini nga babaye nga nanlibog.

en: Again he stooped down and wrote on the ground.
war: Ngan tinmamod na liwat hiya ngan nagsurat ha tuna.

en: Jesus straightened up and asked her, “Woman, where are they? Has no one condemned you?”
war: Hinmangad hi Jesus ngan nagpakiana ha iya, “Hain naman hira, Mana? Waray ba nahibilin hin pagsirot ha imo?”

en: You judge by human standards; I pass judgment on no one.
war: Naghuhukom kamo hin tinawo gudla nga paagi; diri ako naghuhukom bisan kan kanay.

en: In your own Law it is written that the testimony of two witnesses is true.
war: Nahisurat ha iyo Balaod nga kon nagkakauyon in duha nga mga saksi, matuod an ira iginsisiring.

en: I am one who testifies for myself; my other witness is the Father, who sent me.”
war: Nagpapamatuod ako mahitungod ha akon, ngan nagpapamatuod man mahitungod ha akon an Amay nga nagsugo ha akon.”

en: “Who are you?” they asked. “Just what I have been telling you from the beginning,” Jesus replied.
war: “Kay hin-o ka man ngay-an?” nagpakiana hira ha iya. Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Ada, amo ako an iginsumat ko na ha iyo tikang pa hadto.

en: They did not understand that he was telling them about his Father.
war: Waray hira sabot nga naghihimangraw hiya ha ira mahitungod han Amay.

en: Even as he spoke, many believed in him.
war: Tinmoo kan Jesus in damo han mga nagpakabati hini nga mga iginsiring niya.

en: Then you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.”
war: ngan hibabaroan niyo an kamatuoran, ngan an kamatuoran an magtatalwas ha iyo.”

en: Jesus replied, “Very truly I tell you, everyone who sins is a slave to sin.
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Susumatan ko kamo hin tinuod: oripon han sala an ngatanan nga nakakasala.

en: Now a slave has no permanent place in the family, but a son belongs to it forever.
war: Diri dayuday sakop han panimalay an oripon, kundi sakop ha kadayonan an anak.

en: So if the Son sets you free, you will be free indeed.
war: Sanglit matatalwas gud kamo hin tinuod kon an Anak an magtalwas ha iyo.

en: Why is my language not clear to you? Because you are unable to hear what I say.
war: Kay ano nga diri kamo nasabot han akon iginyayakan? Tungod kay diri kamo nailob hin pamati han akon mga mensahe.

en: Yet because I tell the truth, you do not believe me!
war: Nagsusumat ako han kamatuoran, sanglit diri kamo natuod ha akon.

en: The Jews answered him, “Aren’t we right in saying that you are a Samaritan and demon-possessed?”
war: Nagbaton an mga Judiyo kan Jesus, “Diri ba tama an amon pagsiring nga Samaritano ka ngan sinasangkayan ka hin yawa?”

en: “I am not possessed by a demon,” said Jesus, “but I honor my Father and you dishonor me.
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Diri gad ako sinasangkayan hin yawa. Ginpapasidunggan ko la an akon Amay, kundi ginpapakaalohan ako niyo.

en: I am not seeking glory for myself; but there is one who seeks it, and he is the judge.
war: Diri ako nagtitingoha hin dungog ha akon kalugaringon. May-ada hito nagtitinguha ngan naghuhukom ugop ha akon.

en: Very truly I tell you, whoever obeys my word will never see death.”
war: Susumatan ko kamo hin tinuod: diri na mapatay an bisan hin-o nga magtuman han akon pulong.”

en: Your father Abraham rejoiced at the thought of seeing my day; he saw it and was glad.”
war: Nalipay hi Abraham nga amay niyo hin pag-ikinikitaan han adlaw han akon pagkanhi; hinkit-an ini niya ngan nalipay hiya.”

en: “You are not yet fifty years old,” they said to him, “and you have seen Abraham!”
war: Nagsiring ha iya an mga Judiyo, “Waray pa ngani 50 an imo panuigon—ngan hinkit-an mo na hi Abraham?”

en: “Very truly I tell you,” Jesus answered, “before Abraham was born, I am!”
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Susumatan ko kamo hin tinuod: Diri pa tawo hi Abraham, ‘Amo na ako’.”

en: At this, they picked up stones to stone him, but Jesus hid himself, slipping away from the temple grounds.
war: Ngan namurot hira hin mga bato hin pagbato ha iya; kundi tinmago hi Jesus ngan ginmawas ha Templo.

en: As he went along, he saw a man blind from birth.
war: Han naglalakat hi Jesus, nakakita hiya hin tawo nga daan buta tikang han iya katawo.

en: While I am in the world, I am the light of the world.”
war: Ako an kapawa han kalibutan samtang aanhi pa ako ha kalibutan.”

en: “How then were your eyes opened?” they asked.
war: Nagpakiana hira ha iya, “Naunan-o man nga nakita ka na?”

en: “Where is this man?” they asked him. “I don’t know,” he said.
war: “Hain naman hiya?” nagpakiana hira. “Ambot,” nagbaton hiya.

en: They brought to the Pharisees the man who had been blind.
war: Ngan gindara nira ngadto han mga Parisiyo an tawo nga hadto anay buta.

en: Now the day on which Jesus had made the mud and opened the man’s eyes was a Sabbath.
war: Adlaw adto nga Iparahuway han paghimo ni Jesus hin lapok ngan pagtambal niya han kanan tawo mga mata.

en: “We know he is our son,” the parents answered, “and we know he was born blind.
war: Nagbaton an iya mga kag-anak, “Maaram kami nga amon hiya anak, ngan natawo hiya nga daan buta.

en: That was why his parents said, “He is of age; ask him.”
war: Sanglit nagsiring an iya mga kag-anak, “May buot na man hiya; hiya na la an pakianhi.”

en: Then they asked him, “What did he do to you? How did he open your eyes?”
war: Nagpakiana hira, “Ano an ginbuhat niya ha imo? Gin-unan-o niya hin pagtambal han imo mga mata?”

en: Then they hurled insults at him and said, “You are this fellow’s disciple! We are disciples of Moses!
war: Ginpakaraot hiya nira ngan ginsiring, “Ikaw an iya tinun-an, kundi mga tinun-an kami ni Moises.

en: We know that God spoke to Moses, but as for this fellow, we don’t even know where he comes from.”
war: Maaram kami nga nakighimangraw an Dyos kan Moises; mahitungod hito nga tawo, diri ngani kami maaram kon diin hiya tikang!”

en: If this man were not from God, he could do nothing.”
war: Waray gud mahihimo hito nga tawo kon diri hiya tikang ha Dyos.”

en: “Who is he, sir?” the man asked. “Tell me so that I may believe in him.”
war: Nagbaton an tawo, “Sumati gad ako kon hin-o hiya, basi makatoo ako ha iya!”

en: Jesus said, “You have now seen him; in fact, he is the one speaking with you.”
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya, “Hinkit-an mo na hiya, ngan amo hiya nga nakikighimangraw yana ha imo.”

en: Then the man said, “Lord, I believe,” and he worshiped him.
war: “Natoo ako, Ginoo!” nagsiring an tawo, ngan linmuhod hiya ha atubangan ni Jesus.

en: The one who enters by the gate is the shepherd of the sheep.
war: Magmarangno han mga karnero an tawo nga naagi ha porta.

en: But they will never follow a stranger; in fact, they will run away from him because they do not recognize a stranger’s voice.”
war: Diri hira masunod hin iba; lugod makalagiw hira, kay diri nira kinikilala an iya tingog.”

en: Jesus used this figure of speech, but the Pharisees did not understand what he was telling them.
war: Iginsumat ni Jesus ha ira ini nga pananglitan, kundi waray hira makasabot han karuyag sidngon han pananglitan.

en: Therefore Jesus said again, “Very truly I tell you, I am the gate for the sheep.
war: Sanglit nagsiring liwat hi Jesus, “Susumatan ta kamo hin tinuod: amo ako an porta para han mga karnero.

en: All who have come before me are thieves and robbers, but the sheep have not listened to them.
war: Mga kawatan ngan mga tikasan an ngatanan nga kinmanhi una ha akon; kundi waray mamati ha ira an mga karnero.

en: I am the gate; whoever enters through me will be saved. They will come in and go out, and find pasture.
war: Amo ako an porta. Matatalwas an bisan hin-o nga masulod pinaaagi ha akon, masulod-guwa hiya ngan makakaagi hin panibsiban.

en: The man runs away because he is a hired hand and cares nothing for the sheep.
war: Nakalagiw an sinuholan, kay sinuholan man la hiya ngan diri napaid han mga karnero.

en: The reason my Father loves me is that I lay down my life—only to take it up again.
war: “Nahigugma an Amay ha akon kay andam man ako hin paghatag han akon kinabuhi basi mahibalik liwat ini ha akon.

en: The Jews who heard these words were again divided.
war: Nagkabahin na liwat an mga Judiyo tungod hini nga mga pulong.

en: Then came the Festival of Dedication at Jerusalem. It was winter,
war: Inmabot an panahon han pagsaurog han Pyesta han Paghalad didto ha Jerusalem ngan panahon adto hin kathagkot,

en: and Jesus was in the temple courts walking in Solomon’s Colonnade.
war: ngan didto ha Templo naglalakat hi Jesus didto han Balkon ni Solomon.

en: but you do not believe because you are not my sheep.
war: kundi diri kamo matuod kay diri man kamo akon mga karnero.

en: My sheep listen to my voice; I know them, and they follow me.
war: Namamati han akon tingog an akon mga karnero; nakilala ako ha ira, ngan nasunod hira ha akon;

en: I and the Father are one.”
war: Mag-usa la an Amay ug ako.”

en: Again his Jewish opponents picked up stones to stone him,
war: Nanmurot na liwat an mga Judiyo hin mga bato paglabay ha iya.

en: Jesus answered them, “Is it not written in your Law, ‘I have said you are “gods” ’ ?
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Di ba nahisurat ha iyo kalugaringon nga Balaod nga nagsiring an Dyos, ‘Mga dyos kamo’?

en: Do not believe me unless I do the works of my Father.
war: Sanglit angay diri kamo tumoo ha akon kon diri ako nagbubuhat han mga buhat han akon Amay.

en: Again they tried to seize him, but he escaped their grasp.
war: Gin-idarakop na liwat hiya nira, kundi nakapudlos hiya tikang ha ira mga kamot.

en: And in that place many believed in Jesus.
war: Ngan damo nga mga tawo didto in tinmoo kan Jesus.

en: So the sisters sent word to Jesus, “Lord, the one you love is sick.”
war: Nagpatugon ini nga magbugto nga kababayen-an ngadto kan Jesus nga sidngon hiya, “Ginoo, masakit an imo suok nga sangkay.”

en: Now Jesus loved Martha and her sister and Lazarus.
war: Hinigugma ni Jesus hira Marta, Maria, ug Lazaro.

en: So when he heard that Lazarus was sick, he stayed where he was two more days,
war: Han pakabati niya nga masakit hi Lazaro, duha anay ka adlaw an iya ginpalabay san-o hiya kumadto.

en: and then he said to his disciples, “Let us go back to Judea.”
war: Katapos, nagsiring hiya ngadto han iya mga tinun-an, “Tana, balik kita ha Judea.”

en: It is when a person walks at night that they stumble, for they have no light.”
war: Kundi mahipapakdol hiya kon maglakat hiya ha gab-i, kay masirom man.”

en: His disciples replied, “Lord, if he sleeps, he will get better.”
war: Nagbaton an mga tinun-an, “Ginoo, mag-uupay hiya kon nakaturog la hiya.”

en: So then he told them plainly, “Lazarus is dead,
war: Sanglit ginsumatan hira ni Jesus hin waray lipodlipod, “Patay na hi Lazaro;

en: and for your sake I am glad I was not there, so that you may believe. But let us go to him.”
war: kundi tungod ha iyo nalilipay ako nga waray ako didto upod ha iya, basi tumoo kamo. Kadtoa ta hiya.”

en: On his arrival, Jesus found that Lazarus had already been in the tomb for four days.
war: Pag-abot ni Jesus, nasayran niya nga upat na ka adlaw nga iginlubong hi Lazaro.

en: Now Bethany was less than two miles from Jerusalem,
war: Mga tulo la ka kilometro an Betania tikang ha Jerusalem,

en: and many Jews had come to Martha and Mary to comfort them in the loss of their brother.
war: ngan damo nga mga Judiyo an kinmadto hin pagliaw kanda Marta ug Maria mahitungod han kamatay han ira bugto.

en: “Lord,” Martha said to Jesus, “if you had been here, my brother would not have died.
war: Nagsiring hi Marta kan Jesus, “Ginoo, diri unta napatay an akon bugto kon nakanhi ka pa!

en: But I know that even now God will give you whatever you ask.”
war: Kundi maaram ako nga bisan yana, ihahatag ha imo han Dyos an bisan ano nga imo pangaroon ha iya.”

en: Jesus said to her, “Your brother will rise again.”
war: Ginsumatan hiya ni Jesus, “Mababanhaw an imo bugto.”

en: Martha answered, “I know he will rise again in the resurrection at the last day.”
war: Nagbaton hi Marta, “Maaram ako nga mababanhaw hiya ha kataposan nga adlaw.”

en: and whoever lives by believing in me will never die. Do you believe this?”
war: ngan diri na gud mamamatay an bisan hin-o nga buhi nga natoo ha akon. Natuod ka ba hini?”

en: “Where have you laid him?” he asked. “Come and see, Lord,” they replied.
war: Nagpakiana hiya ha ira, “Diin niyo iglubong hiya?” Nagbaton hira, “Kadi, Ginoo, ngan kitaa.”

en: Jesus wept.
war: Nagtangis hi Jesus.

en: Then the Jews said, “See how he loved him!”
war: Sanglit nagsiring an mga Judiyo, “Kitaa, pagkadako han iya paghigugma kan Lazaro!”

en: Jesus, once more deeply moved, came to the tomb. It was a cave with a stone laid across the entrance.
war: Kinmadto hi Jesus ha lubnganan kay inalpan na liwat hiya hin kabido. Usa adto nga lungib nga sinadhan hin bato.

en: Then Jesus said, “Did I not tell you that if you believe, you will see the glory of God?”
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya, “Diri ba nagsiring ako ha imo nga hikikit-an mo an gahom han Dyos kon tumoo ka?”

en: When he had said this, Jesus called in a loud voice, “Lazarus, come out!”
war: Katapos niya magsiring hini, ginmoliat hiya, “Lazaro! Gawas ngadi!”

en: Therefore many of the Jews who had come to visit Mary, and had seen what Jesus did, believed in him.
war: Nakakita han ginbuhat ni Jesus in damo han mga Judiyo nga nagduaw kan Maria, ngan tinmoo hira ha iya.

en: But some of them went to the Pharisees and told them what Jesus had done.
war: Kundi kinmadto han mga Parisiyo an iba ha ira hin pagsumat ha ira han ginbuhat ni Jesus.

en: Then one of them, named Caiaphas, who was high priest that year, spoke up, “You know nothing at all!
war: Nagsiring an usa ha ira, nga Caifas an ngaran, nga amo an Labaw nga Padi hadto nga tuig, “Waray gud kamo makasabot!

en: and not only for that nation but also for the scattered children of God, to bring them together and make them one.
war: ngan diri la para ha ira, kundi pagtirok liwat ngan pag-urosa han ngatanan nga nagkakaburublag nga mga anak han Dyos.

en: So from that day on they plotted to take his life.
war: Tikang hadto nga adlaw, nagkasarabot an mga punoan nga Judiyo hin pagpatay kan Jesus.

en: But one of his disciples, Judas Iscariot, who was later to betray him, objected,
war: Nagsiring an usa han mga tinun-an ni Jesus, hi Judas Iscariote—an maglilingo ha iya,

en: “Why wasn’t this perfume sold and the money given to the poor? It was worth a year’s wages. ”
war: “Kay ano nga waray lugod ibaligya ini nga pahamot hin sais syintos pesos ngan ihatag an kwarta ha mga kablas?”

en: You will always have the poor among you, but you will not always have me.”
war: Dayuday kaupod niyo an mga kablas, kundi diri ako dayuday kaupod niyo.”

en: So the chief priests made plans to kill Lazarus as well,
war: Sanglit nagkasarabot an mga puno han kapadian hin pagpatay kan Lazaro;

en: for on account of him many of the Jews were going over to Jesus and believing in him.
war: kay tungod ha iya damo nga mga Judiyo in nahibulag ha ira ngan tinmoo na kan Jesus.

en: Jesus found a young donkey and sat on it, as it is written:
war: Nakaagi hi Jesus hin asno ngan iya ginsakyan, sugad han nahisurat:

en: “Do not be afraid, Daughter Zion; see, your king is coming, seated on a donkey’s colt.”
war: “Ayaw kahadlok, syudad han Sion! Aanhi naabot an imo Hadi nga nasakay hin nati nga asno.”

en: Many people, because they had heard that he had performed this sign, went out to meet him.
war: Sanglit gintapo hiya han kadam-an, kay hinbatian nira nga ginbuhat niya ini nga urosahon.

en: Now there were some Greeks among those who went up to worship at the festival.
war: May mga Griego nga kaupod han mga kinmadto ha Jerusalem hin pagsingba ha panahon han pyesta.

en: Philip went to tell Andrew; Andrew and Philip in turn told Jesus.
war: Kinmadto hi Felipe pagsumat kan Andres, ngan kinmadto hira nga duha pagsumat kan Jesus.

en: Jesus replied, “The hour has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus ha ira, “Inmabot na yana an takna nga pagpapasidunggan an Anak han Tawo.

en: Jesus said, “This voice was for your benefit, not mine.
war: Kundi nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Diri tungod ha akon nga nagyakan ini nga tingog, kundi tungod ha iyo.

en: Now is the time for judgment on this world; now the prince of this world will be driven out.
war: Ginhuhukman na yana an kalibutan; pupukanon na yana an punoan hini nga kalibutan.

en: And I, when I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to myself.”
war: Kakabigon ko ngadi ha akon an ngatanan nga mga tawo, kon isahon na ako tikang ha tuna.” (

en: He said this to show the kind of death he was going to die.
war: Ha pagsiring niya hini, iginpasabot niya an paagi han kamatayon nga iya pag-aantoson.)

en: Even after Jesus had performed so many signs in their presence, they still would not believe in him.
war: Bisan kon ginbuhat niya ini ngatanan nga mga urosahon ha atubangan nira, waray gihapon hira tumoo ha iya,

en: For this reason they could not believe, because, as Isaiah says elsewhere:
war: Tungod hini waray hira makatoo, kay nagsiring liwat hi Isaias:

en: Isaiah said this because he saw Jesus’ glory and spoke about him.
war: Ginsiring ini ni Isaias kay hinkit-an niya an gahom ni Jesus, ngan nagyakan hiya mahitungod ha iya.

en: for they loved human praise more than praise from God.
war: Ginpalabi nira an pagdayaw ha ira han mga tawo kay han pagdayaw ha ira han Dyos.

en: The one who looks at me is seeing the one who sent me.
war: An bisan hin-o nga nakakakita ha akon nakakakita liwat ha iya nga nagpadara ha akon.

en: I have come into the world as a light, so that no one who believes in me should stay in darkness.
war: Kinmanhi ako usa nga kapawa han kalibutan, basi diri na magpabilin ha kasisidman an ngatanan nga natoo ha akon.

en: He came to Simon Peter, who said to him, “Lord, are you going to wash my feet?”
war: Hinmarani kan Simon Pedro nga nagsiring ha iya, “Ginoo, mamumusa ka ba han akon mga tiil?”

en: Jesus replied, “You do not realize now what I am doing, but later you will understand.”
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus ha iya, “Diri ka pa maaram yana kon ano an akon ginbubuhat, kundi hibabaroan mo ini onina.”

en: For he knew who was going to betray him, and that was why he said not every one was clean.
war: Maaram na hi Jesus kon hin-o an maglilingo ha iya, sanglit nagsiring hiya, “Malinis na kamo kundi diri ngatanan.”)

en: “You call me ‘Teacher’ and ‘Lord,’ and rightly so, for that is what I am.
war: Natawag kamo ha akon nga magturutdo ngan Ginoo, ngan may kamatuoran, kay amo gud ito ako.

en: I have set you an example that you should do as I have done for you.
war: Gintagan ko kamo hin susbaranan, basi sugaron niyo hin pagbuhat han ginbuhat ko ha iyo.

en: Now that you know these things, you will be blessed if you do them.
war: Yana maaram na kamo hini nga kamatuoran; palaran kamo kon buhaton ini niyo!

en: “I am telling you now before it happens, so that when it does happen you will believe that I am who I am.
war: Ginsusumat ko ini ha iyo yana, nga diri pa ini nahinanabo, basi kon mahinabo na ini, tumoo kamo nga hi ‘Ako Amo Ako.’

en: His disciples stared at one another, at a loss to know which of them he meant.
war: Naggipasirosiplat hira nga nanhiburong kon hin-o gud an iya karuyag sidngon.

en: One of them, the disciple whom Jesus loved, was reclining next to him.
war: Nalingkod sapit ni Jesus an hinigugma niya nga tinun-an.

en: Simon Peter motioned to this disciple and said, “Ask him which one he means.”
war: Nagsenyas hi Simon Pedro ha iya ngan nagsiring, “Pakianhi daw hiya kon hin-o an iya hinnanabihan.”

en: Leaning back against Jesus, he asked him, “Lord, who is it?”
war: Sanglit sinmiring kan Jesus adto nga tinun-an ngan nagpakiana, “Hin-o man hiya, Ginoo?”

en: But no one at the meal understood why Jesus said this to him.
war: Waray nakasabot han mga nakada ha lamesa kay ano nga ginsiring ini ni Jesus ha iya.

en: As soon as Judas had taken the bread, he went out. And it was night.
war: Ginkarawat ni Judas an tinapay ngan ginmawas hiya dayon. Gab-i adto.

en: By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you love one another.”
war: Kon magsihigugmaay kamo, mahibabaro an ngatanan nga akon kamo mga tinun-an.”

en: Peter asked, “Lord, why can’t I follow you now? I will lay down my life for you.”
war: Nagpakiana hi Pedro, “Ginoo, kay ano hin diri ko pakasunod ha imo yana? Andam man ako pagpakamatay tungod ha imo!”

en: “Do not let your hearts be troubled. You believe in God ; believe also in me.
war: Nagsiring ha ira hi Jesus, “Ayaw kamo kabaraka ngan kagupong. Too kamo han Dyos ngan too man kamo ha akon.

en: You know the way to the place where I am going.”
war: Maaram na kamo kon uunanhon niyo pagsangpot ngadto han akon kakadtoan.”

en: Thomas said to him, “Lord, we don’t know where you are going, so how can we know the way?”
war: Nagsiring ha iya hi Tomas, “Ginoo, diri kami maaram kon tikain ka; uunanhon man namon paghibaro han dalan nga tipakadto?”

en: Philip said, “Lord, show us the Father and that will be enough for us.”
war: Nagsiring ha iya hi Felipe, “Ginoo, ipakita ha amon an Amay ngan igo na ito para ha amon.”

en: And I will do whatever you ask in my name, so that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
war: Ngan bubuhaton ko an bisan ano nga iyo pangaroon ha akon ngaran, basi pagdayawon an Amay pinaagi han Anak.

en: You may ask me for anything in my name, and I will do it.
war: Bubuhaton ko an bisan ano nga pangaroon niyo ha akon ngaran.

en: “If you love me, keep my commands.
war: “Kon nahigugma kamo ha akon, magtutuman kamo han akon mga sugo.

en: I will not leave you as orphans; I will come to you.
war: “Diri ko kamo babayaan nga mag-uusaan; mabalik ako ngada ha iyo.

en: On that day you will realize that I am in my Father, and you are in me, and I am in you.
war: Kon umabot na ito nga adlaw, hibabaroan niyo nga aada ako han akon Amay, ngan aadi kamo ha akon, sugad nga aada ako ha iyo.

en: “All this I have spoken while still with you.
war: “Iginsumat ko ini ha iyo samtang upod pa ako niyo.

en: I have told you now before it happens, so that when it does happen you will believe.
war: Iginsusumat ko ini ha iyo yana, nga diri pa ini nahinanabo, basi kon mahinabo na ini, tumoo kamo.

en: “I am the true vine, and my Father is the gardener.
war: “Amo ako an tinuod nga balagon, ngan an akon Amay an magmarangno.

en: You are already clean because of the word I have spoken to you.
war: Nalinisan na kamo pinaagi han mensahe nga akon iginhimangraw ha iyo.

en: This is to my Father’s glory, that you bear much fruit, showing yourselves to be my disciples.
war: Ginhihimaya an akon Amay tungod han iyo pamunga hin damo; ngan pinaagi hini, nagigin mga tinun-an ko kamo.

en: “As the Father has loved me, so have I loved you. Now remain in my love.
war: Hinihigugma ko kamo sugad gud han paghigugma ha akon han Amay; pagpabilin kamo didi han akon gugma.

en: I have told you this so that my joy may be in you and that your joy may be complete.
war: “Iginsumat ko ini ha iyo basi mahingada ha iyo an akon kalipay, ngan basi mahingpit an iyo kalipay.

en: My command is this: Love each other as I have loved you.
war: Amo ini an akon sugo: pagsihigugmaay kamo, sugad han paghigugma ko ha iyo.

en: You are my friends if you do what I command.
war: Ngan kasangkayan ko kamo, kon buhaton niyo an akon iginsusugo ha iyo.

en: This is my command: Love each other.
war: Sanglit amo ini an igsusugo ko ha iyo: paggihigugmaay kamo.”

en: “If the world hates you, keep in mind that it hated me first.
war: “Kon magdumot ha iyo an kalibutan, kinahanglan hisabotan niyo nga una ako pagdumtan han kalibutan.

en: Whoever hates me hates my Father as well.
war: An bisan hin-o nga nagdudumot ha akon, nagdudumot man han akon Amay.

en: But this is to fulfill what is written in their Law: ‘They hated me without reason.’
war: Kundi kinahanglan mahinabo ini, basi matuman an iginsurat dida han ira Balaod: ‘Gindumtan ako nira hin waray la hinungdan.’

en: And you also must testify, for you have been with me from the beginning.
war: Ngan magpapamatuod liwat kamo mahitungod ha akon, kay nagin kaupod ko man kamo tikang pa gud ha tinikangan.

en: “All this I have told you so that you will not fall away.
war: “Iginsumat ko ini ha iyo basi diri lumuya an iyo pagtoo ha akon.

en: They will do such things because they have not known the Father or me.
war: Bubuhaton nira ha iyo ini nga mga butang, kay waray hira makakilala han Amay o ha akon.

en: but now I am going to him who sent me. None of you asks me, ‘Where are you going?’
war: Kundi yana, makadto na ako han nagsugo ha akon; kundi waray ha iyo napakiana ha akon, ‘Tikain ka?’

en: Rather, you are filled with grief because I have said these things.
war: Ngan yana nga ginsumatan ko na kamo, nagmamabidoon kamo.

en: about sin, because people do not believe in me;
war: Sayop hira mahitungod han sala, kay diri hira natoo ha akon;

en: about righteousness, because I am going to the Father, where you can see me no longer;
war: mahitungod han pagkamatadong, kay makadto ako han Amay ngan diri na kamo makita ha akon;

en: and about judgment, because the prince of this world now stands condemned.
war: mahitungod han paghukom, kay ginhukman na an punoan hini nga kalibutan.

en: “I have much more to say to you, more than you can now bear.
war: “Damo pa gad an akon igsurumat ha iyo, kundi diri pa ini niyo maaakos yana.

en: He will glorify me because it is from me that he will receive what he will make known to you.
war: Paghihimayaon ako niya, kay natikang ha akon an igsusumat niya ha iyo.

en: Jesus went on to say, “In a little while you will see me no more, and then after a little while you will see me.”
war: “Ha diri maiha, diri na kamo makita ha akon; ngan ha diri liwat maiha makita na liwat kamo ha akon.”

en: They kept asking, “What does he mean by ‘a little while’ ? We don’t understand what he is saying.”
war: Nagpakiana pa hira, “Ano an buot niya sidngon han ‘diri maiha’? Diri kita nasabot han iya ginyiyinakan!”

en: I came from the Father and entered the world; now I am leaving the world and going back to the Father.”
war: Tikang gud ako han Amay ngan kinmanhi ako ha kalibutan; ngan yana mabaya na ako han kalibutan ngan mabalik ako ngadto han Amay.”

en: Then Jesus’ disciples said, “Now you are speaking clearly and without figures of speech.
war: Ngan nagsiring an iya mga tinun-an, “Kitaa, dayag na kaupay an imo pagyakan, ngan diri ka na nagamit hin mga pananglitan.

en: “Do you now believe?” Jesus replied.
war: Nagbaton ha ira hi Jesus, “Natoo na ba kamo yana?

en: I have brought you glory on earth by finishing the work you gave me to do.
war: Iginpakita ko ha tuna an imo himaya; ginhuman ko na an iginpabuhat mo ha akon.

en: Now they know that everything you have given me comes from you.
war: ngan yana maaram hira nga tikang ha imo an ngatanan nga iginhatag mo ha akon.

en: All I have is yours, and all you have is mine. And glory has come to me through them.
war: Imo an ngatanan nga akon, ngan akon man an ngatanan nga imo; ngan napapasidunggan ako tungod ha ira.

en: My prayer is not that you take them out of the world but that you protect them from the evil one.
war: Diri ako nahangyo nga kuhaon mo hira ha kalibutan, kundi nga panalipdan mo hira han Yawa.

en: They are not of the world, even as I am not of it.
war: Diri hira kanan kalibutan, sugad gud nga diri man ako kanan kalibutan.

en: Sanctify them by the truth; your word is truth.
war: Ihalad hira ngada ha imo pinaagi han kamatuoran; an imo pulong amo an kamatuoran.

en: As you sent me into the world, I have sent them into the world.
war: Ginpadara ko hira nganhi ha kalibutan sugad han pagsugoa mo ha akon nganhi ha kalibutan.

en: For them I sanctify myself, that they too may be truly sanctified.
war: Ngan tungod ha ira ihinahalad ko ha imo an akon kalugaringon, basi hira liwat magin tinuod man nga iginhalad ha imo.

en: I have given them the glory that you gave me, that they may be one as we are one—
war: Gintagan ko hira han amo nga himaya nga ihinatag mo ha akon, basi magkaurosa hira sugad nga uusa la kita;

en: When Jesus said, “I am he,” they drew back and fell to the ground.
war: Han pagsiring la ni Jesus, “Amo ako,” inmisol hira ngan nagkatutumba ha tuna.

en: Again he asked them, “Who is it you want?” “Jesus of Nazareth,” they said.
war: Ginpakianhan na liwat hira ni Jesus, “Hin-o gud an iyo ginbibiling?” Nagbaton hira, “Hi Jesus nga taga-Nazaret.”

en: This happened so that the words he had spoken would be fulfilled: “I have not lost one of those you gave me.”
war: Ginsiring niya ini basi matuman an iya iginyakan, “Amay, waray ako kawad-i bisan usa han imo iginhatag ha akon.”)

en: Then the detachment of soldiers with its commander and the Jewish officials arrested Jesus. They bound him
war: Gindakop ngan gingapos hi Jesus han mga sondalo nga upod han ira kapitan, ngan han mga gwardya nga Judiyo.

en: and brought him first to Annas, who was the father-in-law of Caiaphas, the high priest that year.
war: Gindara hiya nira, syahan ngadto kan Anas nga ugangan ni Caifas nga amo an Labaw nga Padi hadto nga tuig.

en: Caiaphas was the one who had advised the Jewish leaders that it would be good if one man died for the people.
war: Hi Caifas an nagsagdon han mga Judiyo nga maoruopay pa nga usa la nga tawo an mamatay para han ngatanan nga katawhan.

en: Meanwhile, the high priest questioned Jesus about his disciples and his teaching.
war: Nagpakiana kan Jesus an Labaw nga Padi mahitungod han iya mga tinun-an ngan mahitungod han iya pagturon-an.

en: Then Annas sent him bound to Caiaphas the high priest.
war: Ngan iginpadara ni Anas hi Jesus nga ginapos pa, ngadto kan Caifas, an Labaw nga Padi.

en: Again Peter denied it, and at that moment a rooster began to crow.
war: Ngan nagsiring na liwat hi Pedro, “Diri,” ngan hito ngahaw nga takna tinmugaok in manok.

en: So Pilate came out to them and asked, “What charges are you bringing against this man?”
war: Sanglit ginmawas na la hi Pilato ngadto ha ira ngan nagpakiana, “Ano in iyo sumbong kontra hini nga tawo?”

en: “If he were not a criminal,” they replied, “we would not have handed him over to you.”
war: Nagbaton hira, “Diri unta namon hiya gindadara nganhi ha imo kon waray pa hiya makagtalapas.”

en: This took place to fulfill what Jesus had said about the kind of death he was going to die.
war: Nahinabo ini basi matuman an iginyakan ni Jesus han paghimangraw niya kon ano nga paagi mamamatay hiya.)

en: Pilate then went back inside the palace, summoned Jesus and asked him, “Are you the king of the Jews?”
war: Sinmulod liwat ha palasyo hi Pilato ngan gintawag hi Jesus. Nagpakiana hiya kan Jesus, “Ikaw ba an hadi han mga Judiyo?”

en: “Is that your own idea,” Jesus asked, “or did others talk to you about me?”
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Kalugaringon mo ba ini nga pakiana, o ginsumatan ka ba hin iba mahitungod ha akon?”

en: They shouted back, “No, not him! Give us Barabbas!” Now Barabbas had taken part in an uprising.
war: Ginmoliat hira pagbaton ha iya, “Diri, ayaw hiya! Karuyag namon hi Barabas?” (Tikasan ini hi Barabas.)

en: Then Pilate took Jesus and had him flogged.
war: Ngan ipinakuha ni Pilato hi Jesus ngan iginpalatob hiya ha ira.

en: and went up to him again and again, saying, “Hail, king of the Jews!” And they slapped him in the face.
war: gindaop hiya, ngan ginsiring, “Mabuhi an Hadi han mga Judiyo!” Ngan gintampalo hiya nira.

en: When Pilate heard this, he was even more afraid,
war: Labi na nga nahadlok hi Pilato han pakabati niya hini.

en: and he went back inside the palace. “Where do you come from?” he asked Jesus, but Jesus gave him no answer.
war: Binmalik hiya pagsulod ngadto han palasyo ngan nagpakiana kan Jesus, “Tikang ka ba diin?” Kundi waray magbaton hi Jesus.

en: Finally Pilate handed him over to them to be crucified. So the soldiers took charge of Jesus.
war: Sanglit igintubyan ha ira ni Pilato hi Jesus, basi igraysang ha kros. Sanglit gindara nira hi Jesus.

en: Pilate answered, “What I have written, I have written.”
war: Nagbaton hi Pilato, “An nahisurat, nahisurat na.”

en: When he had received the drink, Jesus said, “It is finished.” With that, he bowed his head and gave up his spirit.
war: Dinmimdim hi Jesus han bino ngan nagsiring hiya, “Natuman na!” Ngan dinmuko hiya ngan nabunoson hiya han iya kinabuhi.

en: But when they came to Jesus and found that he was already dead, they did not break his legs.
war: Kundi han pag-abot na nira kan Jesus, hinkit-an nira nga patay na hiya, sanglit waray na la nira baria an iya mga bitiis.

en: Instead, one of the soldiers pierced Jesus’ side with a spear, bringing a sudden flow of blood and water.
war: Kundi ginbangkaw an iya kagiliran hin usa han mga sondalo, ngan inmawas dayon in dugo ug tubig. (

en: These things happened so that the scripture would be fulfilled: “Not one of his bones will be broken,”
war: Ginbuhat ini basi matuman an kasuratan nga nasiring, “Waray usa han iya mga tul-an nga mababari.”

en: and, as another scripture says, “They will look on the one they have pierced.”
war: Ngan may-ada lain pa nga bahin han kasuratan nga nasiring, “Makita an mga tawo ngadto hadton ginbangkaw nira.”

en: Because it was the Jewish day of Preparation and since the tomb was nearby, they laid Jesus there.
war: Tungod kay bisperas na adto han Adlaw nga Iparahuway, ngan hirani manla an lubnganan, didto na la nira iglubong hi Jesus.

en: So Peter and the other disciple started for the tomb.
war: Ngan napakadto dayon ha lubnganan hi Pedro ngan an usa nga tinun-an.

en: He bent over and looked in at the strips of linen lying there but did not go in.
war: Inmubo hiya hin paghiling ngan hinkit-an niya an lino nga mga dugnit, kundi waray hiya sumulod.

en: Finally the other disciple, who had reached the tomb first, also went inside. He saw and believed.
war: Ngan sinmulod liwat an tinun-an nga una makaabot han lubnganan; nakakita hiya ngan tinmoo. (

en: (They still did not understand from Scripture that Jesus had to rise from the dead.)
war: Waray pa gihapon hira makasabot han kasuratan nga nagsiring nga kinahanglan mabanhaw hiya.)

en: Then the disciples went back to where they were staying.
war: Ngan nanngoli an mga tinun-an.

en: Now Mary stood outside the tomb crying. As she wept, she bent over to look into the tomb
war: Nagtitinangis hi Maria nga natukdaw ha gawas han lubnganan. Nagtitinangis pa hiya han pag-ubo niya hin paghiling han lubnganan,

en: And with that he breathed on them and said, “Receive the Holy Spirit.
war: Ginhuypan hira niya nga sidngon, “Karawata niyo an Espiritu Santo.

en: Now Thomas (also known as Didymus ), one of the Twelve, was not with the disciples when Jesus came.
war: Diri kaupod nira hi Tomas, (an gintatawag nga karuha) nga usa han dose nga mga tinun-an, han pagpakita ni Jesus ha ira.

en: Thomas said to him, “My Lord and my God!”
war: Nagbaton hi Tomas ha iya, “Ginoo ko ngan Dyos ko!”

en: Jesus performed many other signs in the presence of his disciples, which are not recorded in this book.
war: Ginbuhat ni Jesus in damo pa nga mga milagro ha atubangan han iya mga tinun-an, nga waray mahisurat dida hini nga basahan.

en: Early in the morning, Jesus stood on the shore, but the disciples did not realize that it was Jesus.
war: Han tisirang na an adlaw, tinmindog hi Jesus ha baybayon, kundi waray makakilala an mga tinun-an nga hi Jesus ngay-an adto.

en: He called out to them, “Friends, haven’t you any fish?” “No,” they answered.
war: Nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Nakadakop ba kamo?” “Waray!” binmaton hira.

en: Jesus said to them, “Bring some of the fish you have just caught.”
war: Ngan nagsiring ha ira hi Jesus, “Pagdara ngadi hin mga isda nga iyo pa la nadakop.”

en: Jesus came, took the bread and gave it to them, and did the same with the fish.
war: Sanglit dinmaop hi Jesus, ginkuha an tinapay, ngan iginhatag ha ira, ngan sugad man an mga isda.

en: This was now the third time Jesus appeared to his disciples after he was raised from the dead.
war: Amo ini an ikatulo nga pagpakita ni Jesus han iya mga tinun-an katapos niya mabanhaw.

en: When Peter saw him, he asked, “Lord, what about him?”
war: Han pakakita ni Pedro ha iya, nagsiring hiya kan Jesus, “Ginoo, ano man an mahinanabo hini nga tawo?”

en: I will give you every place where you set your foot, as I promised Moses.
war: Sugad han akon siring kan Moises, iginhatag ko ha imo ug han ngatanan nga akon mga tawo an bug-os nga tuna nga iyo pag-aagian.

en: So Joshua ordered the officers of the people:
war: Ug ginsugo ni Josue an mga pangulo

en: But to the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh, Joshua said,
war: Ginsiring ni Josue an mga banay nira Ruben ug Gad ngan an katunga han banay ni Manases,

en: Before the spies lay down for the night, she went up on the roof
war: Han waray pa magkakahigda an mga mag-irinaw, sinmaka hi Rahab ngadto ha atop

en: Now the men had said to her, “This oath you made us swear will not be binding on us
war: Nagsiring ha iya an mga tawo, “Tutumanon namon ini nga imo ginpasaad ha amon.

en: But if you tell what we are doing, we will be released from the oath you made us swear.”
war: Kundi kon igsumat niyo an amon ginbuhat dinhe, diri kami kinahanglan magtuman han amon saad nga imo ginpasaad ha amon.”

en: After three days the officers went throughout the camp,
war: Kahuman han ikatolo ka adlaw, an mga pangulo nagsudoy han kampo

en: Joshua told the people, “Consecrate yourselves, for tomorrow the Lord will do amazing things among you.”
war: Ginsiring ni Josue an mga tawo, “Paglinis kamo ha iyo kalugaringon kay buwas an Ginoo magbubuhat hin mga milagro dida ha iyo.”

en: Joshua said to the Israelites, “Come here and listen to the words of the Lord your God.

en: So the Lord was with Joshua, and his fame spread throughout the land.
war: Sanglit kaupod ni Josue an Ginoo ug nahibantog hiya ha bug-os nga katunaan.

war: Ano man an akon masisiring yana, Ginoo nga an mga Israelita inmisol ha iya mga kaaway?

war: Nagsiring kan Josue an Ginoo , “Buhat! Kay ano nga nahapa ka man ha tuna?

en: But they took the king of Ai alive and brought him to Joshua.
war: labot han hadi han Ai. Nabihag hiya ngan gindara hiya ngadto kan Josue.

en: Then Joshua built on Mount Ebal an altar to the Lord , the God of Israel,
war: Ngan nagtindog hi Josue didto ha bukid han Ebal hin altar ngadto han Ginoo , an Dyos han Israel.

en: There, in the presence of the Israelites, Joshua wrote on stones a copy of the law of Moses.
war: Didto ngahaw, samtang nagkikita an mga Israelita, ipinatik ha mga bato an Balaod nga ginsurat ni Moises.

en: they came together to wage war against Joshua and Israel.
war: Nagtitirok hira ngatanan ngan gin-urosa nira an ira mga kasondalohan hin paggubat kan Josue ug han mga Israelita.

en: However, when the people of Gibeon heard what Joshua had done to Jericho and Ai,
war: Kundi an mga tawo ha Gabaon nga mga Hibeohanon nakabati han mga ginbuhat ni Josue didto ha Jerico ug Ai,

en: “We are your servants,” they said to Joshua. But Joshua asked, “Who are you and where do you come from?”
war: Sinmiring hira kan Josue, “Andam kami hin pag-alagad ha imo.” Pinmakiana hi Josue ha ira, “Hira hino kamo? Tikang kamo diin?”

en: The Israelites sampled their provisions but did not inquire of the Lord .
war: Kinmarawat an mga tawo han Israel han pagkaon nga tikang ha ira, kundi waray hira pakiana han Ginoo hiunong hini.

en: So Joshua saved them from the Israelites, and they did not kill them.
war: Ug amo ini an ginbuhat ni Josue: ginpanalipdan hira ug waray niya tugoti an mga tawo ha Israel nga pamatayon hira.

en: Then Joshua returned with all Israel to the camp at Gilgal.
war: Kahuman hini, binmalik ngadto han kampo ha Gilgal hira Josue ug an iya mga kasondalohan.

en: Now the five kings had fled and hidden in the cave at Makkedah.
war: Lugaring nagpakakalag-iw an lima nga mga hadi nga Amoreohanon ug nagtitinago hira didto han lungib ha Maceda.

en: When Joshua was told that the five kings had been found hiding in the cave at Makkedah,
war: May-ada nakaagi ha ira ngan nagsumat kan Josue kon diin hira pagtitinago.

war: Niyan nagsiring hi Josue, “Buksi an ganghaan han lungib ngan dad-a niyo ngadi ha akon an lima nga kahadian.”

war: Kahuman hini, binmalik hi Josue ug an iya kasondalohan ngadto han kampo didto ha Gilgal.
